-- [[ controller ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules universalcontroller

local Controller = {}
function Controller.setup() return true end
function Controller.connectPhysics(scope, callback, before)
  local run = game:GetService("RunService")
  before = before or run.PreSimulation or run.Stepped
  local after = run.Heartbeat or run.PostSimulation
  assert(before or after, "sinal de física indisponível")
  if before then
    scope.connect(before, callback)
  end
  if after and after ~= before then
    scope.connect(after, callback)
  end
end
function Controller.create(utils, lifetime, definition)
  local root = lifetime.scope()
  local active, activation, applying = false, nil, false
  local controller = {}
  local function stop()
    active = false
    if activation then
      activation.destroy()
      activation = nil
    end
    if definition.stop then
      definition.stop()
    end
  end
  local function fail(reason)
    applying = true
    pcall(stop)
    utils.setConfig({ [definition.key] = false })
    utils.recordError(definition.key, tostring(reason))
    applying = false
    return false, tostring(reason)
  end
  function controller.sync()
    if applying or not root.alive then
      return true
    end
    applying = true
    local ok, reason = pcall(function()
      local enabled = definition.isEnabled and definition.isEnabled() or utils.getConfigValue(definition.key) == true
      if enabled ~= active then
        if enabled then
          activation = root.child()
          active = true
          local connect = activation.connect
          activation.connect = function(signal, callback)
            return connect(signal, function(...)
              local ok, reason = pcall(callback, ...)
              if not ok then
                fail(reason)
              end
            end)
          end
          assert(definition.start(activation) ~= false, "falha ao iniciar recurso")
        else
          stop()
        end
      end
      if active and definition.update then
        definition.update()
      end
    end)
    if not ok then
      return fail(reason)
    end
    applying = false
    return true
  end
  function controller.setEnabled(enabled)
    if not root.alive then
      return false, "recurso encerrado"
    end
    if not utils.setConfig({ [definition.key] = enabled == true }) then
      return false, "configuração rejeitada"
    end
    local ok, reason = controller.sync()
    if ok and enabled == true and not active then
      return false, "falha ao ativar recurso"
    end
    return ok, reason
  end
  function controller.setValue(value)
    value = tonumber(value)
    if not value or value ~= value or math.abs(value) == math.huge or not definition.valueKey then
      return false, "valor inválido"
    end
    value = math.clamp(value, definition.min or 0, definition.max or 200)
    if not utils.setConfig({ [definition.valueKey] = value }) then
      return false, "configuração rejeitada"
    end
    return controller.sync()
  end
  root.add(utils.observeConfig(function(changes)
    if changes[definition.key] ~= nil or definition.valueKey and changes[definition.valueKey] ~= nil then
      controller.sync()
    end
  end))
  local cleanup = { Disconnect = function() root.destroy() end }
  utils.trackGlobal(cleanup)
  root.add(function() utils.untrackGlobal(cleanup) end)
  root.add(stop)
  function controller.destroy() root.destroy() end
  return controller
end
Controller.__contract = {
  access = { default = "lifetime.manage" },
  provides = { "setup", "create", "connectPhysics" },
  requires = {},
}
return Controller

-- [[ dump discovery ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules dumpdiscovery

local Discovery = {}
function Discovery.setup() return true end
function Discovery.create(token, options)
  local catalog, candidates, errors, capabilities = {}, {}, {}, {}
  local providers, providerSeen, seen, expanded, resolved, gcSeen = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
  local stats = { live = 0, gc = 0, detached = 0 }
  local connection
  local function provider(value, name)
    if type(value) ~= "table" or providerSeen[value] then
      return
    end
    providerSeen[value] = true
    providers[#providers + 1] = { value = value, name = name }
  end
  if type(getgenv) == "function" then
    local ok, value = pcall(getgenv)
    if ok then
      provider(value, "getgenv")
    end
  end
  if type(getfenv) == "function" then
    local ok, value = pcall(getfenv)
    if ok then
      provider(value, "getfenv")
    end
  end
  provider(_G, "_G")
  local roots = #providers
  for index = 1, roots do
    local root = providers[index]
    for _, name in ipairs({ "syn", "krnl", "fluxus" }) do
      local ok, value = pcall(function() return root.value[name] end)
      if ok then
        provider(value, root.name .. "." .. name)
      end
    end
  end
  local function resolve(name)
    if resolved[name] then
      return resolved[name].fn, resolved[name].label
    end
    for _, root in ipairs(providers) do
      local ok, value = pcall(function() return root.value[name] end)
      if ok and type(value) == "function" then
        local label = root.name .. "." .. name
        resolved[name] = { fn = value, label = label }
        capabilities[#capabilities + 1] = name .. "=" .. label
        return value, label
      end
    end
    resolved[name] = {}
    capabilities[#capabilities + 1] = name .. "=unavailable"
  end
  local function record(object, origin, detached)
    if token.cancelled or typeof(object) ~= "Instance" then
      return
    end
    local item = seen[object]
    if not item then
      item = { instance = object, origin = origin, detached = detached, class = options.class(object) }
      seen[object] = item
      catalog[#catalog + 1] = item
    elseif detached then
      item.detached = true
    end
    if not item.enqueued and options.classes[item.class] and options.include(object, item.detached) then
      item.path, item.enqueued, item.name, item.parents = options.path(object), true, options.name(object), {}
      local node = object
      for _ = 1, 200 do
        local ok, parent = pcall(function() return node.Parent end)
        if not ok or typeof(parent) ~= "Instance" then
          break
        end
        item.parents[#item.parents + 1] = { instance = parent, name = options.name(parent) }
        if parent == game then
          break
        end
        node = parent
      end
      candidates[#candidates + 1] = item
      if origin == "game.DescendantAdded" then
        stats.live += 1
      end
      if origin == "getgc.script" then
        stats.gc += 1
      end
      if origin:find(".descendants", 1, true) then
        stats.detached += 1
      end
    end
    return item
  end
  local function expand(object, origin, detached)
    record(object, origin, detached)
    if typeof(object) ~= "Instance" or object == game or not detached or expanded[object] or not options.include(object, true) then
      return
    end
    local readable, parent = pcall(function() return object.Parent end)
    if not readable or typeof(parent) == "Instance" then
      return
    end
    expanded[object] = true
    local ok, children = pcall(function() return object:GetDescendants() end)
    if not ok then
      errors[#errors + 1] = origin .. ": descendants: " .. tostring(children)
      return
    end
    for index, child in ipairs(children) do
      if token.cancelled then
        return
      end
      record(child, origin .. ".descendants", true)
      if index % options.batch == 0 then
        task.wait()
      end
    end
  end
  local function scanAPI(name, used)
    local api, label = resolve(name)
    if not api or used[api] then
      return
    end
    used[api] = true
    local ok, values = options.call(api)
    if not ok or type(values) ~= "table" then
      errors[#errors + 1] = label .. ": discovery: " .. tostring(values)
      return
    end
    local processed = 0
    for _, object in pairs(values) do
      if token.cancelled then
        return
      end
      expand(object, label, options.detached)
      processed += 1
      if processed % options.batch == 0 then
        task.wait()
      end
    end
  end
  local function scanGC()
    local api, label = resolve("getgc")
    if not api then
      return
    end
    local ok, values = options.call(api, false)
    if not ok or type(values) ~= "table" then
      errors[#errors + 1] = label .. ": discovery: " .. tostring(values)
      return
    end
    local visited = 0
    for _, value in pairs(values) do
      if token.cancelled then
        return
      end
      visited += 1
      if type(value) == "function" then
        local scoped, environment = pcall(getfenv, value)
        local readable, object = false, nil
        if scoped and type(environment) == "table" then
          readable, object = pcall(function() return environment.script end)
        end
        if readable and typeof(object) == "Instance" and not gcSeen[object] and options.classes[options.class(object)] then
          gcSeen[object] = true
          record(object, "getgc.script", options.detached)
          local root = object
          for _ = 1, 200 do
            local valid, parent = pcall(function() return root.Parent end)
            if not valid or typeof(parent) ~= "Instance" or parent == game then
              break
            end
            root = parent
          end
          expand(root, "getgc.root", options.detached)
        end
      end
      if visited % options.batch == 0 then
        task.wait()
      end
    end
  end
  local function stop()
    if connection then
      connection:Disconnect()
      connection = nil
    end
  end
  local function scan()
    local connected, result = pcall(function()
      return game.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object) record(object, "game.DescendantAdded", false) end)
    end)
    if connected then
      connection = result
    else
      errors[#errors + 1] = "game.DescendantAdded: " .. tostring(result)
    end
    record(game, "game", false)
    local ok, descendants = pcall(function() return game:GetDescendants() end)
    if ok then
      for index, object in ipairs(descendants) do
        if token.cancelled then
          return
        end
        record(object, "game:GetDescendants", false)
        if index % options.batch == 0 then
          task.wait()
        end
      end
    else
      errors[#errors + 1] = "game:GetDescendants: " .. tostring(descendants)
    end
    local used = {}
    for _, name in ipairs({ "getscripts", "getrunningscripts", "getnilinstances", "getloadedmodules", "getinstances" }) do
      scanAPI(name, used)
    end
    scanGC()
  end
  return { catalog = catalog, candidates = candidates, errors = errors, capabilities = capabilities, stats = stats, scan = scan, stop = stop, resolve = resolve }
end
Discovery.__contract = { access = { default = "tooling.execute" }, provides = { "setup", "create" }, requires = {} }
return Discovery
sources.universal/dumper.luau:
-- [[ dumper ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules dumper

-- module
local Dumper = {}
local Discovery
local activeToken
local activeCallbacks
local status = {
  running = false,
  startedAt = 0,
  folder = nil,
  total = 0,
  processed = 0,
  saved = 0,
  failed = 0,
  bytecode = 0,
  syntaxWarnings = 0,
}

-- configuration
local CONFIG = {
  PREFIX = "SrcDump",
  PROGRESS_EVERY = 25,
  ERROR_BATCH = 8,
  API_TIMEOUT = 10,
  INSTANCE_BATCH = 5000,
  SCRIPT_BATCH = 50,
  SAVE_BYTECODE = true,
  SAVE_DISASSEMBLY = true,
  INCLUDE_NIL_INSTANCES = true,
}

local SCRIPT_CLASSES = {
  Script = true,
  LocalScript = true,
  ModuleScript = true,
}

local REMOTE_CLASSES = {
  RemoteEvent = true,
  RemoteFunction = true,
  UnreliableRemoteEvent = true,
  BindableEvent = true,
  BindableFunction = true,
}

local SYSTEM_NAMES = {
  CoreGui = true,
  CorePackages = true,
  RobloxGui = true,
  RobloxReplicatedStorage = true,
  CoreScripts = true,
  RobloxDefault = true,
  RobloxPlayerScript = true,
}

-- helpers
local function emit(callbacks, name, ...)
  local callback = callbacks and callbacks[name]
  if type(callback) == "function" then
    pcall(callback, ...)
  end
end
local function log(message)
  if type(print) == "function" then
    pcall(print, "[SrcDump] " .. tostring(message))
  end
end
local function line(value) return tostring(value):gsub("[\r\n]", " ") end
local function safeProperty(object, key, fallback)
  local ok, value = pcall(function() return object[key] end)
  if ok and value ~= nil then
    return value
  end
  return fallback
end
local function objectName(object) return tostring(safeProperty(object, "Name", "Unnamed")) end
local function objectClass(object) return tostring(safeProperty(object, "ClassName", "Unknown")) end
local function objectPath(object)
  local ok, value = pcall(function() return object:GetFullName() end)
  return ok and value or objectName(object)
end
local function isInstance(object) return typeof(object) == "Instance" end
local function safeFilename(value)
  local result = tostring(value):gsub("[^%w%._%-]", "_"):gsub("_+", "_"):sub(1, 80)
  if result == "" or result == "." or result == ".." then
    return "unnamed"
  end
  return result
end
local function ensureFolder(path)
  if type(isfolder) == "function" then
    local ok, exists = pcall(isfolder, path)
    if ok and exists then
      return true
    end
  end
  if type(makefolder) ~= "function" then
    return false, "makefolder is unavailable"
  end
  local ok, err = pcall(makefolder, path)
  if ok then
    return true
  end
  if type(isfolder) == "function" then
    local checked, exists = pcall(isfolder, path)
    if checked and exists then
      return true
    end
  end
  return false, tostring(err)
end
local function saveFile(path, content, createdFolders)
  if type(writefile) ~= "function" then
    return false, "writefile is unavailable"
  end
  local directory = path:match("^(.*)/[^/]+$")
  if directory and not createdFolders[directory] then
    local current = ""
    for part in directory:gmatch("[^/]+") do
      current = current == "" and part or current .. "/" .. part
      if not createdFolders[current] then
        local ok, err = ensureFolder(current)
        if not ok then
          return false, "cannot create " .. current .. ": " .. tostring(err)
        end
        createdFolders[current] = true
      end
    end
  end
  local ok, err = pcall(writefile, path, content)
  if not ok then
    return false, tostring(err)
  end
  return true
end
local function allowed(object, allowDetached)
  if not isInstance(object) then
    return false
  end
  local current = object
  for _ = 1, 200 do
    if current == game then
      return true
    end
    if SYSTEM_NAMES[objectName(current)] then
      return false
    end
    local parent = safeProperty(current, "Parent")
    if not isInstance(parent) then
      return allowDetached == true
    end
    current = parent
  end
  return false
end
local function serialize(value)
  if type(value) == "string" then
    return string.format("%q", value)
  end
  local ok, result = pcall(tostring, value)
  return ok and line(result) or "<unavailable>"
end
local function attributes(object)
  local ok, values = pcall(function() return object:GetAttributes() end)
  if not ok or type(values) ~= "table" then
    return "{}"
  end
  local result = {}
  for key, value in pairs(values) do
    result[#result + 1] = line(key) .. "=" .. serialize(value)
  end
  table.sort(result)
  return "{" .. table.concat(result, ", ") .. "}"
end
local function tags(object, collection)
  if not collection then
    return "[]"
  end
  local ok, values = pcall(function() return collection:GetTags(object) end)
  if not ok or type(values) ~= "table" then
    return "[]"
  end
  table.sort(values)
  return "[" .. table.concat(values, ", ") .. "]"
end
local function errorText(value)
  local text = type(value) == "string" and value or ("returned " .. type(value))
  return line(text)
end
local SOURCE_ERRORS = {
  "failed to get script bytecode",
  "failed to get bytecode",
  "failed to decompile",
  "failed to extract",
  "decompilation failed",
  "decompiler error",
  "decompiler timed out",
  "script has no bytecode",
  "no bytecode available",
  "empty bytecode",
  "server scripts are impossible",
  "invalid argument",
  "server error",
  "decompilation error",
}

local function sourceError(value)
  local lower = tostring(value):lower():gsub("^%s*%-%-%[%[", ""):gsub("^%s*%-%-+%s*", ""):gsub("^%s+", "")
  for _, phrase in ipairs(SOURCE_ERRORS) do
    if lower:sub(1, #phrase) == phrase then
      return line(value)
    end
  end
  return nil
end
local function timedCall(token, fn, argument)
  if token.cancelled then
    return false, "Dump canceled"
  end
  local deadline = os.clock() + CONFIG.API_TIMEOUT
  local finished, success, result = false, false, nil
  local worker = task.defer(function()
    local ok, value = pcall(fn, argument)
    success, result, finished = ok, value, true
  end)
  while not finished and not token.cancelled and os.clock() < deadline do
    task.wait()
  end
  if finished then
    return success, result
  end
  if worker and type(task.cancel) == "function" then
    pcall(task.cancel, worker)
  end
  return false, token.cancelled and "Dump canceled" or "API timed out"
end
local function getGameName(token)
  local ok, product = timedCall(token, function() return game:GetService("MarketplaceService"):GetProductInfo(game.PlaceId) end)
  if ok and type(product) == "table" and type(product.Name) == "string" and product.Name:match("%S") then
    return product.Name
  end
  local name = safeProperty(game, "Name")
  if type(name) == "string" and name:match("%S") and name ~= "Game" and name ~= "game" then
    return name
  end
  return "Place_" .. tostring(game.PlaceId)
end
local function nextFolder(gameName)
  local base = CONFIG.PREFIX .. "_" .. safeFilename(gameName)
  if type(isfolder) ~= "function" then
    return base .. "_" .. tostring(os.time())
  end
  local index = 1
  while true do
    local candidate = base .. "_" .. index
    local ok, exists = pcall(isfolder, candidate)
    if not ok then
      return base .. "_" .. tostring(os.time())
    end
    if not exists then
      return candidate
    end
    index += 1
  end
end
-- dump
local function run(token, callbacks)
  if type(writefile) ~= "function" or type(makefolder) ~= "function" then
    return nil, "writefile and makefolder are required"
  end
  local gameName = getGameName(token)
  if token.cancelled then
    return nil, "Dump canceled"
  end
  local createdFolders = {}
  local base = nextFolder(gameName)
  local status = token.status
  local function callAPI(fn, argument) return timedCall(token, fn, argument) end
  local function save(path, content)
    if token.cancelled then
      return false, "Dump canceled"
    end
    return saveFile(path, content, createdFolders)
  end
  status.folder = base
  for _, path in ipairs({ base, base .. "/scripts", base .. "/remotes" }) do
    local ok, err = ensureFolder(path)
    if not ok then
      return nil, "cannot create " .. path .. ": " .. tostring(err)
    end
    createdFolders[path] = true
  end
  if CONFIG.SAVE_BYTECODE then
    local ok, err = ensureFolder(base .. "/bytecode")
    if not ok then
      return nil, "cannot create bytecode folder: " .. tostring(err)
    end
    createdFolders[base .. "/bytecode"] = true
  end
  if CONFIG.SAVE_DISASSEMBLY then
    local ok, err = ensureFolder(base .. "/disassembly")
    if not ok then
      return nil, "cannot create disassembly folder: " .. tostring(err)
    end
    createdFolders[base .. "/disassembly"] = true
  end
  emit(callbacks, "onStatus", "Finding scripts...")
  local discovery = Discovery.create(token, {
    include = allowed,
    class = objectClass,
    path = objectPath,
    name = objectName,
    classes = SCRIPT_CLASSES,
    batch = CONFIG.INSTANCE_BATCH,
    detached = CONFIG.INCLUDE_NIL_INSTANCES,
    call = callAPI,
  })
  token.discovery = discovery
  discovery.scan()
  if token.cancelled then
    return nil, "Dump canceled"
  end
  local catalog, candidates, discoveryErrors = discovery.catalog, discovery.candidates, discovery.errors
  local lookup = discovery.resolve
  status.total = #candidates
  emit(callbacks, "onProgress", 0, #candidates)
  local decompiler, disassembler = lookup("decompile"), lookup("disassemble")
  local compiler = lookup("loadstring")
  local closureReaders, readers, knownClosures, knownReaders = {}, {}, {}, {}
  for _, name in ipairs({ "getscriptclosure", "getscriptfunction" }) do
    local fn, label = lookup(name)
    if fn and not knownClosures[fn] then
      knownClosures[fn] = true
      closureReaders[#closureReaders + 1] = { name = label, fn = fn }
    end
  end
  for _, name in ipairs({ "getscriptbytecode", "dumpstring" }) do
    local fn, label = lookup(name)
    if fn and not knownReaders[fn] then
      knownReaders[fn] = true
      readers[#readers + 1] = { name = label, fn = fn }
    end
  end
  local manifest, errors = {}, table.clone(discoveryErrors)
  local saved, failed, bytecodes, cacheHits, syntaxWarnings = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
  local sourceCache, unresolved = {}, {}
  local folderByInstance, usedFolderNames = { [game] = "" }, { [""] = { _nilinstances = true } }
  local function folderFor(item)
    local chain, current = {}, nil
    for _, node in ipairs(item.parents) do
      if node.instance == game or folderByInstance[node.instance] ~= nil then
        current = node.instance
        break
      end
      chain[#chain + 1] = node
    end
    local folder = current and folderByInstance[current] or "_NilInstances"
    for i = #chain, 1, -1 do
      local node = chain[i]
      local used = usedFolderNames[folder]
      if not used then
        used = {}
        usedFolderNames[folder] = used
      end
      local name = safeFilename(node.name)
      local candidate, suffix = name, 1
      while used[candidate:lower()] do
        suffix += 1
        candidate = name .. "__" .. suffix
      end
      used[candidate:lower()] = true
      folder = folder == "" and candidate or folder .. "/" .. candidate
      folderByInstance[node.instance] = folder
    end
    return folder
  end
  local function concurrent(items, process, batchSize)
    batchSize = batchSize or CONFIG.SCRIPT_BATCH
    local first = 1
    while first <= #items do
      if token.cancelled then
        return false, "Dump canceled"
      end
      local pending, failure = 0, nil
      local last = math.min(#items, first + batchSize - 1)
      for index = first, last do
        local itemIndex, item = index, items[index]
        pending += 1
        task.defer(function()
          local ok, err = xpcall(function() process(itemIndex, item) end, function(message) return debug.traceback(tostring(message), 2) end)
          if not ok then
            failure = failure or err
          end
          pending -= 1
        end)
      end
      repeat
        task.wait()
      until pending == 0
      if failure then
        return false, failure
      end
      first = last + 1
    end
    return not token.cancelled, token.cancelled and "Dump canceled" or nil
  end
  local processed = 0
  local function extract(index, item)
    if token.cancelled then
      return nil, "Dump canceled"
    end
    local object, attempts = item.instance, {}
    local source, method, bytecode, closure
    local function attempt(label, fn, argument, validateSource)
      if token.cancelled then
        return nil
      end
      local success, value = callAPI(fn, argument)
      if token.cancelled then
        return nil
      end
      if not success then
        attempts[#attempts + 1] = label .. ": error: " .. errorText(value)
        return nil
      end
      if type(value) ~= "string" or #value == 0 then
        attempts[#attempts + 1] = label .. ": empty or invalid return (" .. type(value) .. ")"
        return nil
      end
      if validateSource then
        if not value:match("%S") then
          attempts[#attempts + 1] = label .. ": empty source"
          return nil
        end
        local problem = sourceError(value)
        if problem then
          attempts[#attempts + 1] = label .. ": " .. problem
          return nil
        end
      end
      attempts[#attempts + 1] = label .. ": returned " .. #value .. " bytes"
      return value
    end
    do
      if token.cancelled then
        return nil, "Dump canceled"
      end
      local sourceOk, directSource = pcall(function() return object.Source end)
      if sourceOk and type(directSource) == "string" and directSource:match("%S") and not sourceError(directSource) then
        source, method = directSource, "Source"
        attempts[#attempts + 1] = "Source: available"
      else
        attempts[#attempts + 1] = "Source: " .. (sourceOk and "empty or unavailable" or errorText(directSource))
      end
      if not bytecode and #readers > 0 then
        for _, reader in ipairs(readers) do
          bytecode = attempt(reader.name .. "(instance)", reader.fn, object, false)
          if bytecode then
            break
          end
        end
      end
      if not source and bytecode and sourceCache[bytecode] then
        source, method = sourceCache[bytecode], "cached bytecode"
        cacheHits += 1
      end
      if not source and decompiler then
        source = attempt("decompile(instance)", decompiler, object, true)
        if source then
          method = "decompile(instance)"
        end
      end
      if not source and bytecode and decompiler then
        source = attempt("decompile(bytecode)", decompiler, bytecode, true)
        if source then
          method = "decompile(bytecode)"
        end
      end
      if not source and decompiler then
        for _, reader in ipairs(closureReaders) do
          local success, value = callAPI(reader.fn, object)
          if success and type(value) == "function" then
            closure = value
            attempts[#attempts + 1] = reader.name .. ": function obtained"
            source = attempt("decompile(" .. reader.name .. ")", decompiler, closure, true)
            if source then
              method = "decompile(" .. reader.name .. ")"
              break
            end
          else
            attempts[#attempts + 1] = reader.name .. ": " .. (success and ("returned " .. type(value)) or errorText(value))
          end
        end
      end
    end
    local syntaxStatus, syntaxError = "unavailable", nil
    if source and compiler then
      local checked, result = callAPI(function(text)
        local chunk, reason = compiler(text)
        if type(chunk) == "function" then
          return true
        end
        return tostring(reason or "compiler returned no function")
      end, source)
      syntaxStatus = checked and result == true and "valid" or "warning"
      if syntaxStatus == "warning" then
        syntaxWarnings += 1
        status.syntaxWarnings = syntaxWarnings
        syntaxError = errorText(result)
        errors[#errors + 1] = "[SOURCE_SYNTAX_WARNING] " .. line(item.path) .. " | " .. syntaxError
      end
    end
    if source and syntaxStatus ~= "warning" and bytecode and not sourceCache[bytecode] then
      sourceCache[bytecode] = source
    end
    if not decompiler then
      attempts[#attempts + 1] = "decompile: unavailable"
    end
    if #readers == 0 then
      attempts[#attempts + 1] = "bytecode readers unavailable"
    end
    local folder = folderFor(item)
    local filename = ("%s__%s_%04d"):format(safeFilename(item.name), objectClass(object), index)
    local stem = folder ~= "" and folder .. "/" .. filename or filename
    if bytecode and CONFIG.SAVE_BYTECODE then
      local byteOk, byteError = save(base .. "/bytecode/" .. stem .. ".bin", bytecode)
      if byteOk then
        bytecodes += 1
      else
        attempts[#attempts + 1] = "save bytecode: " .. tostring(byteError)
      end
    end
    local context = line(safeProperty(object, "RunContext", "unavailable"))
    local header = table.concat({
      "-- SrcDump",
      "-- index: " .. index,
      "-- class: " .. objectClass(object),
      "-- path: " .. line(item.path),
      "-- discovered_by: " .. item.origin,
      "-- run_context: " .. context,
      "-- method: " .. tostring(method or "none"),
      "-- syntax_status: " .. syntaxStatus,
      syntaxError and ("-- syntax_warning: " .. line(syntaxError)) or "",
      "",
    }, "\n")
    local entry = {
      item = item,
      stem = stem,
      index = index,
      bytecode = bytecode,
      closure = closure,
      attempts = attempts,
      source = source,
    }

    if source then
      local savedOk, saveError = save(base .. "/scripts/" .. stem .. ".lua", header .. source .. "\n")
      if savedOk then
        saved += 1
        manifest[index] = "[OK] " .. line(item.path) .. " | " .. method .. " | scripts/" .. stem .. ".lua"
      else
        attempts[#attempts + 1] = "save source: " .. tostring(saveError)
        unresolved[#unresolved + 1] = entry
        failed += 1
        manifest[index] = "[PENDING] " .. line(item.path)
      end
    else
      unresolved[#unresolved + 1] = entry
      manifest[index] = "[PENDING] " .. line(item.path)
      failed += 1
    end
    processed += 1
    status.total = #candidates
    status.processed, status.saved, status.failed, status.bytecode = processed, saved, failed, bytecodes
    if processed == 1 or processed % CONFIG.PROGRESS_EVERY == 0 then
      emit(callbacks, "onProgress", processed, #candidates, item.path)
    end
  end
  local extracted, extractError = concurrent(candidates, extract)
  discovery.stop()
  if not extracted then
    return nil, extractError
  end
  local collection
  pcall(function() collection = game:GetService("CollectionService") end)
  emit(callbacks, "onStatus", "Saving game data...")
  local tree = { "SrcDump - instances", "", "" }
  local remotes = { "SrcDump - remotes and bindables", "" }
  local remoteCount, instanceCount = 0, 0
  for index, item in ipairs(catalog) do
    if token.cancelled then
      return nil, "Dump canceled"
    end
    local object = item.instance
    if allowed(object, item.detached) then
      local class = objectClass(object)
      local detail = ("[%s] %s | discovered=%s | attributes=%s | tags=%s"):format(
        class,
        line(item.path or objectPath(object)),
        item.origin,
        attributes(object),
        tags(object, collection)
      )
      instanceCount += 1
      tree[#tree + 1] = detail
      if REMOTE_CLASSES[class] then
        remoteCount += 1
        remotes[#remotes + 1] = detail
      end
    end
    if index % CONFIG.INSTANCE_BATCH == 0 then
      task.wait()
    end
  end
  tree[2] = "total=" .. instanceCount
  remotes[2] = "total=" .. remoteCount
  local treeOk, treeError = save(base .. "/tree.txt", table.concat(tree, "\n") .. "\n")
  if not treeOk then
    return nil, "cannot save tree.txt: " .. tostring(treeError)
  end
  local remoteOk, remoteError = save(base .. "/remotes/remotes.txt", table.concat(remotes, "\n") .. "\n")
  if not remoteOk then
    return nil, "cannot save remotes.txt: " .. tostring(remoteError)
  end
  local info = {
    "SrcDump - game information",
    "place_id=" .. tostring(game.PlaceId),
    "game_id=" .. tostring(game.GameId),
    "job_id=" .. tostring(game.JobId),
    "game_name=" .. line(gameName),
    "creator_id=" .. tostring(game.CreatorId),
    "creator_type=" .. tostring(game.CreatorType),
    "place_version=" .. tostring(game.PlaceVersion),
    "instances=" .. instanceCount,
    "scripts=" .. #candidates,
    "remotes=" .. remoteCount,
  }

  info[#info + 1] = "product_name=" .. line(gameName)
  local infoOk, infoError = save(base .. "/game_info.txt", table.concat(info, "\n") .. "\n")
  if not infoOk then
    return nil, "cannot save game_info.txt: " .. tostring(infoError)
  end
  local function finalizeFailure(_, entry)
    if entry.source then
      manifest[entry.index] = "[ERROR] " .. line(entry.item.path) .. " | write failed"
      errors[#errors + 1] = "[WRITE_ERROR] " .. line(entry.item.path) .. "\n  " .. table.concat(entry.attempts, "\n  ")
    else
      if CONFIG.SAVE_DISASSEMBLY and disassembler then
        local function disassemble(argument)
          local ok, value = callAPI(disassembler, argument)
          if ok and type(value) == "string" and #value > 0 and not sourceError(value) then
            return value
          end
          return nil
        end
        local assembly = disassemble(entry.item.instance)
        if not assembly and entry.bytecode then
          assembly = disassemble(entry.bytecode)
        end
        if not assembly and entry.closure then
          assembly = disassemble(entry.closure)
        end
        if assembly then
          save(base .. "/disassembly/" .. entry.stem .. ".txt", assembly .. "\n")
        end
      end
      local category = entry.bytecode and "bytecode read; source extraction failed" or "bytecode extraction failed"
      errors[#errors + 1] = "[SOURCE_ERROR] "
        .. line(entry.item.path)
        .. " | "
        .. objectClass(entry.item.instance)
        .. " | "
        .. category
        .. " | run_context="
        .. line(safeProperty(entry.item.instance, "RunContext", "unavailable"))
        .. " | discovered_by="
        .. entry.item.origin
        .. "\n  "
        .. table.concat(entry.attempts, "\n  ")
      manifest[entry.index] = "[ERROR] " .. line(entry.item.path) .. " | " .. category
    end
    status.saved, status.failed, status.bytecode = saved, failed, bytecodes
  end
  local finalized, finalizeError = concurrent(unresolved, finalizeFailure, CONFIG.ERROR_BATCH)
  if not finalized then
    return nil, finalizeError
  end
  if token.cancelled then
    return nil, "Dump canceled"
  end
  status.saved, status.failed = saved, failed
  local manifestOk, manifestError = save(base .. "/manifest.txt", table.concat(manifest, "\n") .. "\n")
  if not manifestOk then
    return nil, "cannot save manifest.txt: " .. tostring(manifestError)
  end
  local errorsOk, errorsError = save(base .. "/errors.txt", #errors > 0 and table.concat(errors, "\n\n") .. "\n" or "No errors.\n")
  if not errorsOk then
    return nil, "cannot save errors.txt: " .. tostring(errorsError)
  end
  local capabilitiesOk, capabilitiesError = save(base .. "/capabilities.txt", table.concat(discovery.capabilities, "\n") .. "\n")
  if not capabilitiesOk then
    return nil, "cannot save capabilities.txt: " .. tostring(capabilitiesError)
  end
  local summaryOk, summaryError = save(
    base .. "/summary.txt",
    table.concat({
      "SrcDump",
      "folder=" .. base,
      "game_name=" .. line(gameName),
      "total_found=" .. #candidates,
      "decompiled_and_saved=" .. saved,
      "source_syntax_warnings=" .. syntaxWarnings,
      "source_syntax_validation=" .. (compiler and "available" or "unavailable"),
      "failed=" .. failed,
      "bytecode_saved=" .. bytecodes,
      "source_cache_hits=" .. cacheHits,
      "discovered_live=" .. discovery.stats.live,
      "discovered_gc=" .. discovery.stats.gc,
      "discovered_detached_descendants=" .. discovery.stats.detached,
      "extraction_workers=" .. CONFIG.SCRIPT_BATCH,
      "discovery_errors=" .. #discoveryErrors,
      "instances=" .. instanceCount,
      "remotes=" .. remoteCount,
      "note=Only content accessible to the client environment can be captured.",
      "",
    }, "\n")
  )
  if not summaryOk then
    return nil, "cannot save summary.txt: " .. tostring(summaryError)
  end
  log(("Finished: %d saved, %d failed, %d source warnings. Folder: %s"):format(saved, failed, syntaxWarnings, base))
  return {
    folder = base,
    total = #candidates,
    saved = saved,
    failed = failed,
    bytecode = bytecodes,
    syntaxWarnings = syntaxWarnings,
  }
end

-- lifecycle
function Dumper.setup(deps)
  Dumper.stop()
  Discovery = deps.Discovery
  return true
end
function Dumper.start(callbacks)
  if activeToken then
    return false, "A dump is already running"
  end
  if type(callbacks) ~= "table" then
    callbacks = {}
  end
  local token = { cancelled = false }
  activeToken, activeCallbacks = token, callbacks
  status = {
    running = true,
    startedAt = os.clock(),
    folder = nil,
    total = 0,
    processed = 0,
    saved = 0,
    failed = 0,
    bytecode = 0,
    syntaxWarnings = 0,
  }

  token.status = status
  task.spawn(function()
    local ok, result, reason = xpcall(
      function() return run(token, callbacks) end,
      function(errorValue) return debug and type(debug.traceback) == "function" and debug.traceback(tostring(errorValue), 2) or tostring(errorValue) end
    )
    if token.discovery then
      token.discovery.stop()
    end
    if activeToken ~= token then
      return
    end
    local callbacks = activeCallbacks
    activeToken, activeCallbacks = nil, nil
    status.running = false
    if token.cancelled then
      emit(callbacks, "onCanceled")
      return
    end
    if not ok or not result then
      local message = not ok and result or reason or "Dump failed"
      emit(callbacks, "onError", message)
      return
    end
    status.folder = result.folder
    status.syntaxWarnings = result.syntaxWarnings
    status.total, status.saved, status.failed, status.bytecode = result.total, result.saved, result.failed, result.bytecode
    emit(callbacks, "onComplete", table.clone(result))
  end)
  return true
end
function Dumper.stop()
  status.running = false
  if activeToken then
    local callbacks = activeCallbacks
    activeToken.cancelled = true
    if activeToken.discovery then
      activeToken.discovery.stop()
    end
    activeToken, activeCallbacks = nil, nil
    emit(callbacks, "onCanceled")
    log("Dump canceled.")
  end
  return true
end
function Dumper.isRunning() return activeToken ~= nil end
function Dumper.getStatus() return table.clone(status) end
function Dumper.teardown() return Dumper.stop() end

-- contract
Dumper.__contract = {
  access = { default = "tooling.execute" },
  requires = { Discovery = "dumpdiscovery" },
  requiresMethods = { Discovery = { "create" } },
  provides = { "setup", "start", "stop", "isRunning", "getStatus", "teardown" },
}

return Dumper

-- [[ fly ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules fly

local Fly = {}

local Utils
local controller

-- configuration
local CONFIG = {
  schema = {
    UniversalFly = "boolean",
    UniversalFlySpeed = "rate",
  },
  defaults = {
    UniversalFly = false,
    UniversalFlySpeed = 1,
  },
}

local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local states = { Fly = false }
local epoch = 0
local flyCharacter
local flyHumanoid
local flyRoot
local flyVelocity
local flyGyro
local flyPlatformStand
local flyAutoRotate
local playerControls
local playerControlsModule
local pressedKeys = {}
local controls = { Forward = 0, Backward = 0, Left = 0, Right = 0, Up = 0, Down = 0 }
local bindings = {
  [Enum.KeyCode.W] = { "Forward", 1 },
  [Enum.KeyCode.S] = { "Backward", -1 },
  [Enum.KeyCode.A] = { "Left", -1 },
  [Enum.KeyCode.D] = { "Right", 1 },
  [Enum.KeyCode.E] = { "Up", 1 },
  [Enum.KeyCode.Q] = { "Down", -1 },
  [Enum.KeyCode.Space] = { "Up", 1 },
  [Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl] = { "Down", -1 },
}

local connections = {}
local connectionPool
local function disconnect(name)
  if connectionPool then
    connectionPool.disconnect(name)
  end
end
local function connect(name, signal, callback) return connectionPool.connect(name, signal, callback) end
local function disconnectPrefix(prefix)
  for name in pairs(connections) do
    if name:sub(1, #prefix) == prefix then
      disconnect(name)
    end
  end
end
local function destroy(object)
  if object then
    pcall(object.Destroy, object)
  end
end
local function clearControls()
  table.clear(pressedKeys)
  for key in pairs(controls) do
    controls[key] = 0
  end
end
local function detachFly()
  if flyRoot and flyRoot.Parent then
    pcall(function() flyRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero end)
  end
  destroy(flyVelocity)
  destroy(flyGyro)
  if flyHumanoid and flyHumanoid.Parent then
    pcall(function()
      if flyPlatformStand ~= nil then
        flyHumanoid.PlatformStand = flyPlatformStand
      end
      if flyAutoRotate ~= nil then
        flyHumanoid.AutoRotate = flyAutoRotate
      end
    end)
  end
  flyCharacter, flyHumanoid, flyRoot, flyVelocity, flyGyro = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
  flyPlatformStand, flyAutoRotate = nil, nil
end
local function flyCharacterReady()
  local player = Utils.getLocalPlayer()
  local character = player and player.Character
  local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  if not character or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not root then
    detachFly()
    return nil
  end
  if flyCharacter ~= character or flyHumanoid ~= humanoid or flyRoot ~= root then
    detachFly()
    flyCharacter, flyHumanoid, flyRoot = character, humanoid, root
    flyPlatformStand, flyAutoRotate = humanoid.PlatformStand, humanoid.AutoRotate
  end
  if not flyVelocity or not flyVelocity.Parent then
    flyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    flyVelocity.Name = "ExodusFlyVelocity"
    flyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
    flyVelocity.P = 9e4
    flyVelocity.Parent = root
  end
  if not flyGyro or not flyGyro.Parent then
    flyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
    flyGyro.Name = "ExodusFlyGyro"
    flyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
    flyGyro.P = 9e4
    flyGyro.D = 1000
    flyGyro.Parent = root
  end
  return humanoid
end
local function getPlayerControls()
  if playerControls and playerControlsModule and playerControlsModule.Parent then
    return playerControls
  end
  local player = Utils.getLocalPlayer()
  local scripts = player and player:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
  local module = scripts and scripts:FindFirstChild("PlayerModule")
  if not module then
    return nil
  end
  local owner = epoch
  local ok, value = pcall(require, module)
  if owner ~= epoch or not Utils or not states.Fly then
    return nil
  end
  if ok and type(value) == "table" and type(value.GetControls) == "function" then
    local ready, result = pcall(value.GetControls, value)
    if owner == epoch and Utils and states.Fly and ready and result and type(result.GetMoveVector) == "function" then
      playerControls, playerControlsModule = result, module
    end
  end
  return playerControls
end
local function updateFly()
  if not Utils or not states.Fly then
    return
  end
  local owner = epoch
  local humanoid = flyCharacterReady()
  local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
  if not humanoid or not camera then
    return
  end
  local direction
  local typing = UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() ~= nil
  if typing then
    clearControls()
  end
  if typing then
    direction = Vector3.zero
  elseif UIS.TouchEnabled and UIS:GetLastInputType() == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
    local controller = getPlayerControls()
    if controller then
      local movement = controller:GetMoveVector()
      direction = camera.CFrame.RightVector * movement.X - camera.CFrame.LookVector * movement.Z
    else
      direction = humanoid.MoveDirection
    end
  else
    direction = camera.CFrame.LookVector * (controls.Forward + controls.Backward)
      + camera.CFrame.RightVector * (controls.Left + controls.Right)
      + Vector3.new(0, controls.Up + controls.Down, 0)
  end
  if owner ~= epoch or not states.Fly or not Utils or humanoid ~= flyHumanoid or not flyRoot or not flyRoot.Parent then
    return
  end
  if direction.Magnitude > 1 then
    direction = direction.Unit
  end
  local speed = math.clamp(tonumber(Utils.getConfigValue("UniversalFlySpeed")) or 1, 0.1, 10)
  local velocity = direction * speed * 50
  if not flyVelocity or not flyVelocity.Parent or not flyGyro or not flyGyro.Parent then
    return
  end
  flyVelocity.Velocity = velocity
  flyRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = velocity
  flyGyro.CFrame = camera.CFrame
  humanoid.PlatformStand = true
  humanoid.AutoRotate = false
end
local function startFly(scope, connectPhysics)
  connect("FlyBegan", UIS.InputBegan, function(input, processed)
    if processed then
      return
    end
    local binding = bindings[input.KeyCode]
    if binding then
      pressedKeys[input.KeyCode] = true
      controls[binding[1]] = binding[2]
    end
  end)
  connect("FlyEnded", UIS.InputEnded, function(input)
    local binding = bindings[input.KeyCode]
    if binding then
      pressedKeys[input.KeyCode] = nil
      controls[binding[1]] = 0
      for key in pairs(pressedKeys) do
        local held = bindings[key]
        if held and held[1] == binding[1] then
          controls[held[1]] = held[2]
          break
        end
      end
    end
  end)
  connect("FlyFocus", UIS.WindowFocusReleased, clearControls)
  connectPhysics(scope, updateFly)
  updateFly()
  return true
end
local function stopFly()
  epoch += 1
  disconnectPrefix("Fly")
  clearControls()
  detachFly()
  playerControls, playerControlsModule = nil, nil
  return true
end
function Fly.setEnabled(value)
  if not controller then
    return false, "recurso indisponível"
  end
  return controller.setEnabled(value)
end
function Fly.setValue(value)
  if not controller then
    return false, "recurso indisponível"
  end
  return controller.setValue(value)
end
function Fly.teardown()
  if controller then
    controller.destroy()
    controller = nil
  end
  stopFly()
  states.Fly = false
  if connectionPool then
    connectionPool.destroy()
    connectionPool = nil
  end
  Utils = nil
  return true
end
function Fly.setup(deps)
  Fly.teardown()
  Utils = deps.Utils
  connectionPool = deps.Lifetime.connections(Utils)
  connections = connectionPool.connections
  controller = deps.Controller.create(Utils, deps.Lifetime, {
    key = "UniversalFly",
    valueKey = "UniversalFlySpeed",
    min = 0.1,
    max = 10,
    start = function(scope)
      states.Fly = true
      assert(startFly(scope, deps.Controller.connectPhysics), "sinal de física indisponível")
    end,
    stop = function()
      states.Fly = false
      stopFly()
    end,
    update = updateFly,
  })
  return controller.sync()
end
Fly.__config = CONFIG

-- contract
Fly.__contract = {
  requires = { Utils = "utils", Lifetime = "lifetime", Controller = "universalcontroller" },
  requiresMethods = {
    Lifetime = { "connections", "scope" },
    Controller = { "create", "connectPhysics" },
    Utils = { "getConfigValue", "setConfig", "observeConfig", "getLocalPlayer", "trackGlobal", "untrackGlobal", "recordError" },
  },
  provides = { "setup", "teardown", "setEnabled", "setValue" },
}

return Fly

-- [[ gravity ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules gravity

local Gravity = {}

local Utils
local controller

-- configuration
local CONFIG = {
  schema = {
    UniversalGravityEnabled = "boolean",
    UniversalGravity = "rate",
  },
  defaults = { UniversalGravityEnabled = false },
  resolveDefaults = function() return { UniversalGravity = game:GetService("Workspace").Gravity or 196.2 } end,
}

local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local gravityValue
local enabledState = false
local gravityRoot
local attachment
local force
local function clearGravity()
  if force then
    force:Destroy()
    force = nil
  end
  if attachment then
    attachment:Destroy()
    attachment = nil
  end
  gravityRoot = nil
end
local function updateGravity()
  if not Utils or not enabledState then
    return
  end
  local player = Utils.getLocalPlayer()
  local character = player and player.Character
  local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not root or not root.Parent then
    clearGravity()
    return
  end
  if gravityRoot ~= root or not force or not force.Parent or not attachment or not attachment.Parent then
    clearGravity()
    gravityRoot = root
    attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
    attachment.Name = "ExodusGravityAttachment"
    attachment.Parent = root
    force = Instance.new("VectorForce")
    force.Name = "ExodusGravityForce"
    force.Attachment0 = attachment
    force.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
    force.ApplyAtCenterOfMass = true
    force.Parent = root
  end
  local mass = root.AssemblyMass
  local compensation = (not root.Anchored and mass == mass and mass < math.huge) and mass * (Workspace.Gravity - gravityValue) or 0
  local desired = Vector3.new(0, compensation, 0)
  if force.Force ~= desired then
    force.Force = desired
  end
end
function Gravity.setEnabled(value)
  if not controller then
    return false, "recurso indisponível"
  end
  return controller.setEnabled(value)
end
function Gravity.setValue(value)
  if not controller then
    return false, "recurso indisponível"
  end
  return controller.setValue(value)
end
function Gravity.teardown()
  if controller then
    controller.destroy()
    controller = nil
  end
  clearGravity()
  enabledState, Utils = false, nil
  return true
end
function Gravity.setup(deps)
  Gravity.teardown()
  Utils = deps.Utils
  gravityValue = tonumber(Utils.getConfigValue("UniversalGravity")) or Workspace.Gravity
  controller = deps.Controller.create(Utils, deps.Lifetime, {
    key = "UniversalGravityEnabled",
    valueKey = "UniversalGravity",
    min = 0,
    max = 400,
    start = function(scope)
      enabledState = true
      deps.Controller.connectPhysics(scope, updateGravity)
    end,
    stop = function()
      enabledState = false
      clearGravity()
    end,
    update = function()
      gravityValue = math.clamp(tonumber(Utils.getConfigValue("UniversalGravity")) or Workspace.Gravity, 0, 400)
      updateGravity()
    end,
  })
  return controller.sync()
end
Gravity.__config = CONFIG

-- contract
Gravity.__contract = {
  requires = { Utils = "utils", Lifetime = "lifetime", Controller = "universalcontroller" },
  requiresMethods = {
    Utils = { "getConfigValue", "setConfig", "observeConfig", "getLocalPlayer", "trackGlobal", "untrackGlobal", "recordError" },
    Lifetime = { "scope" },
    Controller = { "create", "connectPhysics" },
  },
  provides = { "setup", "teardown", "setEnabled", "setValue" },
}

return Gravity

-- [[ infinitejump ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules infinitejump

local InfiniteJump = {}

local Utils
local hub
local controller

-- configuration
local CONFIG = {
  schema = { UniversalInfiniteJump = "boolean" },
  defaults = { UniversalInfiniteJump = false },
}

local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local states = { InfiniteJump = false }
local connectionPool
local function disconnect(name)
  if connectionPool then
    connectionPool.disconnect(name)
  end
end
local function connect(name, signal, callback) return connectionPool.connect(name, signal, callback) end
local jumpButton
local lastJump = 0
local function jumpInAir()
  if not Utils or not states.InfiniteJump or UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() then
    return
  end
  local player = Utils.getLocalPlayer()
  local character = player and player.Character
  local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or humanoid.Sit or not root or humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
    return
  end
  local now = os.clock()
  if now - lastJump < 0.08 then
    return
  end
  local power = humanoid.UseJumpPower and humanoid.JumpPower or math.sqrt(math.max(0, 2 * Workspace.Gravity * humanoid.JumpHeight))
  if power ~= power or power <= 0 or power == math.huge or root.Anchored then
    return
  end
  lastJump = now
  local velocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
  root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(velocity.X, power, velocity.Z)
  humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
end
local function attachJumpButton()
  if not Utils or not states.InfiniteJump then
    return
  end
  local button = hub.getJumpButton()
  if not button then
    local player = Utils.getLocalPlayer()
    local gui = player and player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
    local touch = gui and gui:FindFirstChild("TouchGui")
    local frame = touch and touch:FindFirstChild("TouchControlFrame")
    button = frame and frame:FindFirstChild("JumpButton")
  end
  if button == jumpButton then
    return
  end
  disconnect("GameJump")
  jumpButton = button
  if button and button:IsA("GuiButton") then
    connect("GameJump", button.MouseButton1Down, jumpInAir)
  end
end
local function startInfiniteJump()
  lastJump = 0
  connect("InfiniteJump", UIS.JumpRequest, jumpInAir)
  local player = Utils.getLocalPlayer()
  local gui = player and player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
  if gui then
    local queued = false
    connect("JumpGuiAdded", gui.DescendantAdded, function()
      if queued then
        return
      end
      queued = true
      task.defer(function()
        queued = false
        attachJumpButton()
      end)
    end)
    connect("JumpGuiRemoving", gui.DescendantRemoving, function(object)
      if object == jumpButton then
        disconnect("GameJump")
        jumpButton = nil
      end
    end)
  end
  attachJumpButton()
  return true
end
local function stopInfiniteJump()
  disconnect("InfiniteJump")
  disconnect("GameJump")
  disconnect("JumpGuiAdded")
  disconnect("JumpGuiRemoving")
  jumpButton = nil
  return true
end
function InfiniteJump.setEnabled(value)
  if not controller then
    return false, "recurso indisponível"
  end
  return controller.setEnabled(value)
end
function InfiniteJump.teardown()
  if controller then
    controller.destroy()
    controller = nil
  end
  stopInfiniteJump()
  states.InfiniteJump = false
  if connectionPool then
    connectionPool.destroy()
    connectionPool = nil
  end
  Utils, hub = nil, nil
  return true
end
function InfiniteJump.setup(deps)
  InfiniteJump.teardown()
  Utils, hub = deps.Utils, deps.Hub
  connectionPool = deps.Lifetime.connections(Utils)
  controller = deps.Controller.create(Utils, deps.Lifetime, {
    key = "UniversalInfiniteJump",
    start = function()
      states.InfiniteJump = true
      assert(startInfiniteJump())
    end,
    stop = function()
      states.InfiniteJump = false
      stopInfiniteJump()
    end,
  })
  return controller.sync()
end
InfiniteJump.__config = CONFIG

-- contract
InfiniteJump.__contract = {
  requires = { Utils = "utils", Lifetime = "lifetime", Hub = "hubapi", Controller = "universalcontroller" },
  requiresMethods = {
    Hub = { "getJumpButton" },
    Lifetime = { "connections", "scope" },
    Controller = { "create" },
    Utils = { "getConfigValue", "setConfig", "observeConfig", "getLocalPlayer", "trackGlobal", "untrackGlobal", "recordError" },
  },
  provides = { "setup", "teardown", "setEnabled" },
}

return InfiniteJump

-- [[ invisicam ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules invisicam

local Invisicam = {}
local controller, assist
local CONFIG = { schema = { UniversalInvisicam = "boolean" }, defaults = { UniversalInvisicam = false } }
local function create(utils)
  local Player = utils.getLocalPlayer()
  local Services = { RunService = game:GetService("RunService") }
  local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
  local Runtime = { ShuttingDown = false }
  local CameraAssist = {
    Enabled = false,
    Sources = {},
    Connection = nil,
    RaycastParams = nil,
    OverlapParams = nil,
    SavedOcclusionMode = nil,
    OcclusionModeManaged = false,
    OriginalLocalTransparency = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
    CurrentOccluders = {},
    OccluderTransparency = 0.82,
    CheckInterval = 0.1,
    LastCheckAt = 0,
    LastWarningAt = -math.huge,
  }

  local OCCLUSION_MODE = Enum.DevCameraOcclusionMode.Invisicam

  -- diagnostics
  function CameraAssist:_Warn(message)
    local now = os.clock()
    if now - self.LastWarningAt < 5 then
      return
    end
    self.LastWarningAt = now
    utils.recordError("Invisicam", message)
  end

  -- visibility
  function CameraAssist:_FadeOccluder(part)
    if self.OcclusionModeManaged or not part:IsA("BasePart") then
      return
    end
    if self.OriginalLocalTransparency[part] == nil then
      local readOk, original = pcall(function() return part.LocalTransparencyModifier end)
      if not readOk then
        return
      end
      self.OriginalLocalTransparency[part] = original
    end
    self.CurrentOccluders[part] = true
    pcall(function() part.LocalTransparencyModifier = self.OccluderTransparency end)
  end
  function CameraAssist:_IsOccluder(part)
    if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart") then
      return false
    end
    local ok, transparency, localTransparency = pcall(function() return part.Transparency, part.LocalTransparencyModifier end)
    return ok and transparency < 0.98 and localTransparency < 0.98
  end
  function CameraAssist:_RestoreUnusedOccluders()
    for part, original in pairs(self.OriginalLocalTransparency) do
      if not self.CurrentOccluders[part] then
        if part.Parent then
          pcall(function() part.LocalTransparencyModifier = original end)
        end
        self.OriginalLocalTransparency[part] = nil
      end
    end
  end
  function CameraAssist:_RestoreAllOccluders()
    for part, original in pairs(self.OriginalLocalTransparency) do
      if part.Parent then
        pcall(function() part.LocalTransparencyModifier = original end)
      end
      self.OriginalLocalTransparency[part] = nil
    end
    table.clear(self.CurrentOccluders)
  end
  function CameraAssist:_TracePath(origin, targetPosition, excludedParts, excludedInstances)
    local direction = targetPosition - origin
    if direction.Magnitude <= 0.05 then
      return false
    end
    local occluded = false
    for _ = 1, 16 do
      self.RaycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = excludedInstances
      local result = Workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, self.RaycastParams)
      if not result then
        return occluded
      end
      local instance = result.Instance
      if instance == Workspace.Terrain then
        return true
      end
      if not instance:IsA("BasePart") or excludedParts[instance] then
        return occluded
      end
      if self:_IsOccluder(instance) then
        occluded = true
        self:_FadeOccluder(instance)
      end
      excludedParts[instance] = true
      table.insert(excludedInstances, instance)
    end
    return occluded
  end
  local function getBodySamples(part)
    local size = part.Size
    local axes = {
      { Size = size.X, Vector = part.CFrame.RightVector },
      { Size = size.Y, Vector = part.CFrame.UpVector },
      { Size = size.Z, Vector = part.CFrame.LookVector },
    }

    table.sort(axes, function(left, right) return left.Size > right.Size end)
    local samples = { part.Position }
    for index = 1, math.min(2, #axes) do
      local offset = axes[index].Vector * axes[index].Size * 0.42
      table.insert(samples, part.Position + offset)
      table.insert(samples, part.Position - offset)
    end
    return samples
  end
  function CameraAssist:_UpdateOccluders(camera, character, humanoid, root)
    local cameraPosition = camera.CFrame.Position
    table.clear(self.CurrentOccluders)
    local excludedParts = { [character] = true }
    local excludedInstances = { character }
    self.RaycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = excludedInstances
    self.OverlapParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = excludedInstances
    local insideParts = Workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(cameraPosition), Vector3.new(0.08, 0.08, 0.08), self.OverlapParams)
    for _, part in ipairs(insideParts) do
      if self:_IsOccluder(part) then
        self:_FadeOccluder(part)
        if not excludedParts[part] then
          excludedParts[part] = true
          table.insert(excludedInstances, part)
        end
      end
    end
    local targets = {}
    for _, part in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
      if part:IsA("BasePart") and part ~= root and part.Transparency < 1 then
        table.insert(targets, part)
      end
    end
    if #targets == 0 then
      self:_RestoreUnusedOccluders()
      return
    end
    if humanoid.Health > 0 then
      for _, target in ipairs(targets) do
        for _, sample in ipairs(getBodySamples(target)) do
          local pathExcludedParts = {}
          local pathExcludedInstances = {}
          for _, instance in ipairs(excludedInstances) do
            pathExcludedParts[instance] = true
            table.insert(pathExcludedInstances, instance)
          end
          self:_TracePath(cameraPosition, sample, pathExcludedParts, pathExcludedInstances)
        end
      end
    end
    self:_RestoreUnusedOccluders()
  end
  function CameraAssist:_Update()
    if not self.Enabled or Runtime.ShuttingDown then
      return
    end
    local now = os.clock()
    if now - self.LastCheckAt < self.CheckInterval then
      return
    end
    self.LastCheckAt = now
    if self.OcclusionModeManaged then
      local modeOk, currentMode = pcall(function() return Player.DevCameraOcclusionMode end)
      if modeOk and currentMode ~= OCCLUSION_MODE then
        local setOk = pcall(function() Player.DevCameraOcclusionMode = OCCLUSION_MODE end)
        if not setOk then
          self.OcclusionModeManaged = false
        end
      end
    end
    local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    local character = Player.Character
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not camera or not character or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
      self:_RestoreAllOccluders()
      return
    end
    local ok, updateError = pcall(function() self:_UpdateOccluders(camera, character, humanoid, root) end)
    if not ok then
      self:_RestoreAllOccluders()
      self:_Warn("não foi possível atualizar a transparência da câmera: " .. tostring(updateError))
    end
  end

  -- lifecycle
  function CameraAssist:_HasActiveSource()
    for _, active in pairs(self.Sources) do
      if active then
        return true
      end
    end
    return false
  end
  function CameraAssist:_Activate()
    if self.Enabled or Runtime.ShuttingDown then
      return
    end
    self.Enabled = true
    local readOk, originalMode = pcall(function() return Player.DevCameraOcclusionMode end)
    if readOk then
      local setOk, setError = pcall(function() Player.DevCameraOcclusionMode = OCCLUSION_MODE end)
      if setOk then
        self.SavedOcclusionMode = originalMode
        self.OcclusionModeManaged = true
      else
        self:_Warn("o modo Invisicam não pôde ser ativado: " .. tostring(setError))
      end
    end
    local setupOk, setupError = pcall(function()
      local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
      raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
      local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
      overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
      overlapParams.MaxParts = 32
      self.RaycastParams = raycastParams
      self.OverlapParams = overlapParams
      self.Connection = self.Scope.connect(Services.RunService.RenderStepped, function()
        local updateOk, updateError = pcall(function() self:_Update() end)
        if not updateOk then
          self:_Warn("erro ao atualizar a câmera: " .. tostring(updateError))
        end
      end)
    end)
    if not setupOk then
      self:_Deactivate()
      self:_Warn("não foi possível iniciar a assistência da câmera: " .. tostring(setupError))
    end
  end
  function CameraAssist:_Deactivate()
    self.Enabled = false
    if self.Connection then
      pcall(function() self.Connection:Disconnect() end)
      self.Connection = nil
    end
    if self.OcclusionModeManaged then
      pcall(function() Player.DevCameraOcclusionMode = self.SavedOcclusionMode end)
    end
    self.SavedOcclusionMode = nil
    self.OcclusionModeManaged = false
    self:_RestoreAllOccluders()
    self.RaycastParams = nil
    self.OverlapParams = nil
  end
  function CameraAssist:Shutdown()
    table.clear(self.Sources)
    self:_Deactivate()
  end

  return CameraAssist
end
function Invisicam.setEnabled(value)
  if not controller then
    return false, "recurso indisponível"
  end
  return controller.setEnabled(value)
end
function Invisicam.setSource(source, enabled)
  if not controller or type(source) ~= "string" or source == "" then
    return false
  end
  assist.Sources[source] = enabled == true and true or nil
  return controller.sync()
end
function Invisicam.teardown()
  if controller then
    controller.destroy()
    controller = nil
  end
  if assist then
    assist:Shutdown()
    assist = nil
  end
  return true
end
function Invisicam.setup(deps)
  Invisicam.teardown()
  local utils = deps.Utils
  assist = create(utils)
  controller = deps.Controller.create(utils, deps.Lifetime, {
    key = "UniversalInvisicam",
    isEnabled = function() return utils.getConfigValue("UniversalInvisicam") == true or assist:_HasActiveSource() end,
    start = function(scope)
      assist.Scope = scope
      assist:_Activate()
      return assist.Enabled
    end,
    stop = function() assist:_Deactivate() end,
  })
  return controller.sync()
end
Invisicam.__config = CONFIG
Invisicam.__contract = {
  access = { methods = { setSource = "world.write" } },
  requires = { Utils = "utils", Lifetime = "lifetime", Controller = "universalcontroller" },
  requiresMethods = {
    Utils = { "getConfigValue", "setConfig", "observeConfig", "getLocalPlayer", "trackGlobal", "untrackGlobal", "recordError" },
    Lifetime = { "scope" },
    Controller = { "create" },
  },
  provides = { "setup", "teardown", "setEnabled", "setSource" },
}
return Invisicam

-- [[ noclip ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules noclip

local Noclip = {}
local controller, state, scope
local CONFIG = { schema = { UniversalNoclip = "boolean" }, defaults = { UniversalNoclip = false } }
local function create(utils, resources, connectPhysics)
  local Services = { RunService = game:GetService("RunService") }
  local Player = utils.getLocalPlayer()
  local Runtime = {
    ShuttingDown = false,
    ConnectPhysics = function(_, callback)
      local physics = resources.child()
      connectPhysics(physics, callback, Services.RunService.Stepped)
      return { Disconnect = physics.destroy }
    end,
    Track = function(_, connection) return resources.add(connection) end,
    OnShutdown = function(_, cleanup) resources.add(cleanup) end,
  }
  local State = {
    Enabled = false,
    Owners = {},
    Character = nil,
    SteppedConnection = nil,
    DescendantConnection = nil,
    OriginalCanCollide = {},
    BindGeneration = 0,
    BindThread = nil,
  }

  local function hasOwners() return next(State.Owners) ~= nil end
  local function disconnect(connection)
    if connection then
      pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end)
    end
  end
  local function cancelPendingBind()
    local thread = State.BindThread
    State.BindThread = nil
    if thread then
      pcall(task.cancel, thread)
    end
  end
  local function disablePart(part)
    if not part:IsA("BasePart") then
      return
    end
    local readOk, canCollide = pcall(function() return part.CanCollide end)
    if not readOk then
      return
    end
    if State.OriginalCanCollide[part] == nil then
      State.OriginalCanCollide[part] = canCollide
    end
    pcall(function() part.CanCollide = false end)
  end
  function State:_RestoreBinding()
    cancelPendingBind()
    disconnect(self.SteppedConnection)
    self.SteppedConnection = nil
    disconnect(self.DescendantConnection)
    self.DescendantConnection = nil
    for part, canCollide in pairs(self.OriginalCanCollide) do
      if part.Parent then
        pcall(function() part.CanCollide = canCollide end)
      end
    end
    table.clear(self.OriginalCanCollide)
    self.Character = nil
  end
  function State:_BindCharacter(character)
    self.BindGeneration += 1
    local generation = self.BindGeneration
    if character and self.Character == character then
      return
    end
    self:_RestoreBinding()
    if not character or not hasOwners() then
      return
    end
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid then
      local thread
      thread = task.defer(function()
        local candidate = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
        if self.BindThread == thread then
          self.BindThread = nil
        end
        if candidate and candidate:IsA("Humanoid") and self.BindGeneration == generation and hasOwners() and Player.Character == character then
          self:_BindCharacter(character)
        end
      end)
      self.BindThread = thread
      return
    end
    if humanoid.Health <= 0 then
      return
    end
    self.Character = character
    for _, descendant in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
      disablePart(descendant)
    end
    self.DescendantConnection = character.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(descendant)
      if self.Character == character and hasOwners() then
        disablePart(descendant)
      end
    end)
    self.SteppedConnection = Runtime:ConnectPhysics(function()
      if self.Character ~= character or not hasOwners() then
        self:_RestoreBinding()
        return
      end
      if Player.Character ~= character then
        return
      end
      for part in pairs(self.OriginalCanCollide) do
        if part.Parent then
          pcall(function() part.CanCollide = false end)
        else
          self.OriginalCanCollide[part] = nil
        end
      end
    end)
  end
  function State:Acquire(owner)
    if owner == nil then
      return false
    end
    self.Owners[owner] = true
    self:_BindCharacter(Player.Character)
    return true
  end
  function State:Release(owner)
    if owner ~= nil then
      self.Owners[owner] = nil
    end
    if not hasOwners() then
      self:_RestoreBinding()
    elseif not self.Character then
      self:_BindCharacter(Player.Character)
    end
  end
  function State:Start()
    if self.Enabled or Runtime.ShuttingDown then
      return
    end
    self.Enabled = true
    self:Acquire(self)
  end
  function State:Stop()
    self.Enabled = false
    self:Release(self)
  end
  Runtime:Track(Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
    if hasOwners() then
      State:_BindCharacter(character)
    end
  end))
  Runtime:Track(Player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(character)
    if State.Character == character or State.BindThread then
      State:_BindCharacter(nil)
    end
  end))
  Runtime:OnShutdown(function() State:Stop() end)

  resources.add(function()
    Runtime.ShuttingDown = true
    table.clear(State.Owners)
    State:_BindCharacter(nil)
  end)
  return State
end
function Noclip.setEnabled(value)
  if not controller then
    return false, "recurso indisponível"
  end
  return controller.setEnabled(value)
end
function Noclip.acquire(owner) return state and state:Acquire(owner) or false end
function Noclip.release(owner)
  if not state then
    return false
  end
  state:Release(owner)
  return true
end
function Noclip.teardown()
  if controller then
    controller.destroy()
    controller = nil
  end
  if scope then
    scope.destroy()
    scope = nil
  end
  state = nil
  return true
end
function Noclip.setup(deps)
  Noclip.teardown()
  local utils = deps.Utils
  scope = deps.Lifetime.scope()
  state = create(utils, scope, deps.Controller.connectPhysics)
  local cleanup = { Disconnect = scope.destroy }
  utils.trackGlobal(cleanup)
  scope.add(function() utils.untrackGlobal(cleanup) end)
  controller = deps.Controller.create(utils, deps.Lifetime, {
    key = "UniversalNoclip",
    start = function() state:Start() end,
    stop = function() state:Stop() end,
  })
  return controller.sync()
end
Noclip.__config = CONFIG
Noclip.__contract = {
  access = { methods = { acquire = "world.write", release = "world.write" } },
  requires = { Utils = "utils", Lifetime = "lifetime", Controller = "universalcontroller" },
  requiresMethods = {
    Utils = { "getConfigValue", "setConfig", "observeConfig", "getLocalPlayer", "trackGlobal", "untrackGlobal", "recordError" },
    Lifetime = { "scope" },
    Controller = { "create", "connectPhysics" },
  },
  provides = { "setup", "teardown", "setEnabled", "acquire", "release" },
}
return Noclip

-- [[ servers ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules servers

local Servers = {}

local utils
local failureConnection
local generation = 0
local busy = false
local busyUntil = 0
local reporter = nil
local pendingServerId

-- configuration
local CONFIG = {
  MAX_PING_MS = 100,
  MAX_PAGES = 3,
  PAGE_SIZE = 100,
  PAGE_DELAY = 0.5,
  TELEPORT_TIMEOUT = 15,
}

-- helpers
local function finite(v) return type(v) == "number" and v == v and v > -math.huge and v < math.huge end
local function begin(callback)
  if not utils or not utils.isActive() then
    return nil, "Hub inativo"
  end
  if busy and os.clock() < busyUntil then
    return nil, "Já existe uma busca ou um teleporte em andamento"
  end
  generation = generation + 1
  busy, busyUntil, reporter, pendingServerId = true, os.clock() + 60, callback, nil
  return generation
end
local function report(message)
  if type(reporter) == "function" then
    local ok, reason = pcall(reporter, message)
    if not ok and utils then
      utils.recordError("Servers.callback", reason)
    end
  end
end
local function teleport(serverId, token)
  if token ~= generation or not utils or not utils.isActive() then
    return false, "Operação cancelada"
  end
  local player = utils.getLocalPlayer()
  if not player then
    busy = false
    return false, "Jogador indisponível"
  end
  busyUntil, pendingServerId = os.clock() + CONFIG.TELEPORT_TIMEOUT, serverId
  local ok, err = pcall(function() game:GetService("TeleportService"):TeleportToPlaceInstance(game.PlaceId, serverId, player) end)
  if token ~= generation or not utils then
    return false, "Operação cancelada"
  end
  if not ok then
    busy, pendingServerId = false, nil
    return false, tostring(err)
  end
  task.delay(CONFIG.TELEPORT_TIMEOUT, function()
    if token ~= generation or not busy or not utils then
      return
    end
    busy, pendingServerId = false, nil
    report("O teleporte não foi concluído; você pode tentar novamente")
  end)
  return true
end

-- actions
function Servers.rejoin(callback)
  local token, err = begin(callback)
  if not token then
    return false, err
  end
  if type(game.JobId) ~= "string" or game.JobId == "" then
    busy = false
    return false, "Servidor atual indisponível"
  end
  report("Reconectando ao servidor atual...")
  return teleport(game.JobId, token)
end
function Servers.hop(callback)
  local token, err = begin(callback)
  if not token then
    return false, err
  end
  local http = game:GetService("HttpService")
  local best, cursor
  local seenCursors = {}
  report("Buscando servidores com ping informado de até " .. CONFIG.MAX_PING_MS .. " ms...")
  for page = 1, CONFIG.MAX_PAGES do
    if token ~= generation or not utils or not utils.isActive() then
      return false, "Operação cancelada"
    end
    local url = ("https://games.roblox.com/v1/games/%s/servers/Public?sortOrder=Asc&limit=%d&excludeFullGames=true"):format(
      tostring(game.PlaceId),
      CONFIG.PAGE_SIZE
    )
    if cursor then
      url = url .. "&cursor=" .. http:UrlEncode(cursor)
    end
    local ok, result = pcall(function() return http:JSONDecode(game:HttpGet(url)) end)
    if token ~= generation or not utils or not utils.isActive() then
      return false, "Operação cancelada"
    end
    if not ok or type(result) ~= "table" or type(result.data) ~= "table" then
      busy = false
      return false, "Falha ao consultar servidores: " .. tostring(result)
    end
    for _, server in ipairs(result.data) do
      if
        type(server) == "table"
        and type(server.id) == "string"
        and server.id ~= ""
        and server.id ~= game.JobId
        and finite(server.playing)
        and finite(server.maxPlayers)
        and server.playing >= 0
        and server.maxPlayers > 0
        and server.playing < server.maxPlayers
        and finite(server.ping)
        and server.ping > 0
        and server.ping <= CONFIG.MAX_PING_MS
      then
        if not best or server.ping < best.ping or (server.ping == best.ping and server.playing < best.playing) then
          best = server
        end
      end
    end
    cursor = result.nextPageCursor
    if type(cursor) ~= "string" or cursor == "" or seenCursors[cursor] then
      break
    end
    seenCursors[cursor] = true
    if page < CONFIG.MAX_PAGES then
      task.wait(CONFIG.PAGE_DELAY)
    end
  end
  if token ~= generation or not utils or not utils.isActive() then
    return false, "Operação cancelada"
  end
  if not best then
    busy = false
    return false, "Nenhum outro servidor com vaga e ping informado de até " .. CONFIG.MAX_PING_MS .. " ms foi encontrado"
  end
  report(("Entrando no servidor com menor ping informado: %.0f ms..."):format(best.ping))
  return teleport(best.id, token)
end

-- lifecycle
function Servers.teardown()
  generation = generation + 1
  busy, reporter, pendingServerId = false, nil, nil
  if failureConnection then
    if utils then
      utils.untrackGlobal(failureConnection)
    end
    failureConnection:Disconnect()
    failureConnection = nil
  end
  utils = nil
  return true
end
function Servers.setup(deps)
  Servers.teardown()
  if type(deps) ~= "table" or type(deps.Utils) ~= "table" then
    return false, "Utils ausente"
  end
  utils = deps.Utils
  failureConnection = game:GetService("TeleportService").TeleportInitFailed:Connect(function(player, _, message, placeId, options)
    if not utils or player ~= utils.getLocalPlayer() or placeId ~= game.PlaceId or not busy or not pendingServerId then
      return
    end
    if options and options.ServerInstanceId ~= "" and options.ServerInstanceId ~= pendingServerId then
      return
    end
    busy, pendingServerId = false, nil
    report("Teleporte falhou: " .. tostring(message))
    utils.recordError("Servers", message)
  end)
  utils.trackGlobal(failureConnection)
  return true
end

-- contract
Servers.__contract = {
  access = { default = "tooling.execute" },
  requires = { Utils = "utils" },
  requiresMethods = { Utils = { "getLocalPlayer", "isActive", "trackGlobal", "untrackGlobal", "recordError" } },
  provides = { "setup", "teardown", "rejoin", "hop" },
}

return Servers
