    preferred, expected = geometry.stats(tool).type and tool or nil, nil
  elseif heldTool ~= tool then
    if tool and tool ~= expected and geometry.stats(tool).type ~= nil then
      preferred = tool
    end
    heldTool, equippedAt, expected = tool, now, nil
  end
  return { player = player, character = character, root = root, humanoid = human, camera = camera, eye = geometry.eye(root, character), tool = tool, now = now }
end
function Native.blocked(snap)
  releaseStaleInput()
  return dispatching == true
    or (controller and controller.IsBlocked())
    or player:GetAttribute("MenuOpen") == true
    or snap.character:GetAttribute("EatingApple") == true
    or snap.character:GetAttribute("DrinkingPotion") == true
    or snap.character:GetAttribute("BowDrawStarted")
    or player:GetAttribute("OffhandUsing") == true
    or snap.root.Anchored
end
function Native.find(snap, kind, hotbarOnly)
  local slots = inventory.slots()
  for slot = 1, 9 do
    local tool = slots and slots[slot]
    if
      tool
      and tool.Parent
      and (tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("Count")) or 1) > 0
      and (geometry.stats(tool).type == kind or tool:GetAttribute("ClassItem") == kind)
    then
      return tool
    end
  end
  if hotbarOnly then
    return nil
  end
  for _, parent in ipairs({ snap.character, player:FindFirstChild("Backpack") }) do
    for _, tool in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
      if
        tool:IsA("Tool")
        and (geometry.stats(tool).type == kind or tool:GetAttribute("ClassItem") == kind)
        and (tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("Count")) or 1) > 0
      then
        return tool
      end
    end
  end
  return nil
end
function Native.equip(snap, tool)
  if not tool or not tool.Parent or (tool.Parent ~= snap.character and tool.Parent ~= player:FindFirstChild("Backpack")) then
    return false
  end
  if dispatching and tool.Parent ~= snap.character then
    return false
  end
  if snap.tool == tool then
    return true
  end
  expected = tool
  local slots = inventory.slots()
  if slots then
    for slot = 1, 9 do
      if slots[slot] == tool then
        return inventory.select(snap, slot)
      end
    end
    return false
  end
  return snap.character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") == tool
end
local function selectable(snap, tool)
  if not tool or not tool.Parent or (tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("Count")) or 1) <= 0 then
    return false
  end
  if tool.Parent ~= snap.character and tool.Parent ~= player:FindFirstChild("Backpack") then
    return false
  end
  local slots = inventory.slots()
  if not slots then
    return true
  end
  for slot = 1, 9 do
    if slots[slot] == tool then
      return true
    end
  end
  return false
end
function Native.restore(snap, previous, exact)
  if exact then
    if selectable(snap, previous) then
      return Native.equip(snap, previous)
    elseif previous == nil then
      snap.humanoid:UnequipTools()
      return snap.character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") == nil
    end
  end
  local tool = selectable(snap, preferred) and preferred
    or selectable(snap, previous) and geometry.stats(previous).type and previous
    or Native.find(snap, "sword", true)
    or selectable(snap, previous) and previous
  return not tool or Native.equip(snap, tool)
end
function Native.weapon(snap, target)
  local tool = preferred
  if tool and not selectable(snap, tool) then
    tool = nil
  end
  if tool and not geometry.melee(tool) then
    return nil
  end
  tool = tool or (geometry.melee(snap.tool) and snap.tool) or Native.find(snap, "sword", true)
  if target and geometry.blocking(target.character) then
    local slots = inventory.slots()
    for slot = 1, 9 do
      local axe = slots and slots[slot]
      if selectable(snap, axe) and geometry.stats(axe).type == "axe" then
        return axe
      end
    end
  end
  return tool
end
function Native.holdUse(snap, begin)
  if not controller or type(controller.BeginTouch) ~= "function" or type(controller.EndTouch) ~= "function" then
    return false
  end
  if begin then
    if holdingUse == snap.character then
      return true
    end
    if Native.blocked(snap) then
      return false
    end
    dispatching, dispatchUntil = true, os.clock() + 0.5
    local ok, accepted = pcall(controller.BeginTouch, "Use")
    dispatching = false
    holdingUse = ok and accepted and snap.character or nil
    return holdingUse ~= nil
  end
  if holdingUse then
    pcall(controller.EndTouch, "Use")
    holdingUse = nil
  end
  return true
end
function Native.charge(snap)
  local speed = geometry.stats(snap.tool).speed or 1.6
  local at = math.max(lastAttack, equippedAt, tonumber(snap.character:GetAttribute("LocalAttackSwing")) or -math.huge)
  local current = math.clamp((snap.now - at) * speed, 0, 1)
  if charge and type(charge.Charge) == "function" then
    local ok, value = pcall(charge.Charge)
    if ok and type(value) == "number" then
      current = math.min(current, math.clamp(value, 0, 1))
    end
  end
  return current
end
local function call(action, snap, direction)
  if Native.blocked(snap) then
    return false
  end
  local fn = bridge.get(action == "Attack" and "attack" or "use")
  local oldDirection, oldFrame = player:GetAttribute("FrontCameraAimDirection"), player:GetAttribute("FrontCameraAimCFrame")
  local aimFrame
  local function restore()
    if restoreAim ~= restore then
      return
    end
    restoreAim, dispatching = nil, false
    local ok, reason = pcall(function()
      if player:GetAttribute("FrontCameraAimDirection") == direction then
        player:SetAttribute("FrontCameraAimDirection", oldDirection)
      end
      if aimFrame and player:GetAttribute("FrontCameraAimCFrame") == aimFrame then
        player:SetAttribute("FrontCameraAimCFrame", oldFrame)
      end
    end)
    if not ok then
      utils.recordError("mcpvp.input.restore", tostring(reason))
    end
  end
  restoreAim, dispatching, dispatchUntil = restore, true, os.clock() + 0.5
  local marker = snap.character:GetAttribute("LocalAttackSwing")
  local ok, accepted = pcall(function()
    aimFrame = CFrame.lookAt(snap.eye, snap.eye + direction)
    player:SetAttribute("FrontCameraAimDirection", direction)
    player:SetAttribute("FrontCameraAimCFrame", aimFrame)
    if fn then
      return fn(direction) ~= false
    end
    if not controller or type(controller.BeginTouch) ~= "function" or type(controller.EndTouch) ~= "function" then
      if not missingInput then
        utils.recordError("mcpvp.input", "Ataque/uso nativo e ControllerInput indisponíveis.")
        missingInput = true
      end
      return false
    end
    if not controller.BeginTouch(action) then
      return false
    end
    controller.EndTouch(action)
    return true
  end)
  if fn or not ok then
    restore()
  else
    task.defer(restore)
  end
  if not ok then
    utils.recordError("mcpvp.native." .. action, tostring(accepted))
    return false
  end
  if action == "Use" and fn then
    local class = snap.tool and snap.tool:GetAttribute("ClassItem")
    local config = library("GameConfig")
    local item = config and config.Items[class]
    local drinking = class == "InvisPotion" or item and item.effect and not item.splash
    if not drinking then
      return snap.character:GetAttribute("LocalAttackSwing") ~= marker
    end
  end
  return accepted == true
end
function Native.useState(snap, action, effect)
  if action.character ~= snap.character then
    return false
  end
  local tool = action.tool
  if not tool.Parent or (tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("Count")) or action.count) < action.count then
    return true
  end
  if effect and (tonumber(snap.character:GetAttribute("Effect_" .. effect)) or 0) > workspace:GetServerTimeNow() then
    return true
  end
  if snap.now - action.requestAt >= 3 then
    return false
  end
  return nil
end
function Native.attack(snap, target, direction)
  if snap.now - lastAttack < 1 / 7 or Native.blocked(snap) then
    return false
  end
  direction = snap.camera.CFrame.LookVector
  if not geometry.inView(snap, target) or not geometry.hit(snap, target, snap.tool, direction) then
    return false
  end
  local sent = call("Attack", snap, direction)
  if sent then
    lastAttack = snap.now
  end
  return sent
end
function Native.use(snap, tool, direction)
  local class = tool and tool:GetAttribute("ClassItem")
  if type(class) ~= "string" or (tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("Count")) or 0) < 1 or not Native.equip(snap, tool) or Native.blocked(snap) then
    return false
  end
  local config = library("GameConfig")
  local cooldown = config and config.Items[class] and config.Items[class].cooldown or 0.36
  if snap.now - (lastUse[class] or -math.huge) < cooldown then
    return false
  end
  if (tonumber(player:GetAttribute("ItemCooldown_" .. class)) or 0) > workspace:GetServerTimeNow() then
    return false
  end
  snap.tool = tool
  local sent = call("Use", snap, direction)
  if sent then
    lastUse[class] = snap.now
  end
  return sent
end
function Native.jump(snap)
  if Native.blocked(snap) or snap.humanoid.Sit or snap.humanoid.PlatformStand then
    return false
  end
  snap.humanoid.Jump = true
  snap.humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
  return true
end
function Native.sprint(snap, stop, force)
  local folder = storage:FindFirstChild("VoxelCombat")
  local remote = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("Sprint")
  if not remote then
    return
  end
  if stop then
    if sprintOwner ~= snap.character then
      sprintOwner, sprintWasOn = snap.character, snap.character:GetAttribute("Sprinting") == true or snap.character:GetAttribute("SprintRequested") == true
    end
    if force or snap.now >= (sprintAt or 0) then
      remote:FireServer(false)
      sprintAt = snap.now + 0.08
    end
  elseif sprintOwner then
    if
      sprintOwner == snap.character
      and sprintWasOn
      and player:GetAttribute("SprintToggleEnabled") == true
      and snap.humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.05
    then
      remote:FireServer(true)
    end
    sprintOwner, sprintWasOn, sprintAt = nil, nil, nil
  end
end
function Native.gate(fn)
  callback = fn
  if hooked or not fn or os.clock() < nextHook then
    return hooked ~= nil
  end
  nextHook = os.clock() + 1
  local env = type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv() or _G
  local attack = bridge.get("attack")
  if not attack or type(env.hookfunction) ~= "function" then
    return false
  end
  local previous
  local ok, value = pcall(env.hookfunction, attack, function(direction)
    if dispatching or not callback then
      return previous(direction)
    end
    local snap = Native.snapshot()
    if not snap then
      return previous(direction)
    end
    local success, allow = pcall(callback, snap, direction)
    if not success then
      utils.recordError("mcpvp.manual", tostring(allow))
      return previous(direction)
    end
    if allow then
      return previous(direction)
    end
  end)
  if ok and type(value) == "function" then
    previous, original, hooked, hooker = value, value, attack, env.hookfunction
  end
  return hooked ~= nil
end
function Native.isDispatching() return dispatching == true end
function Native.busy()
  releaseStaleInput()
  return dispatching == true
end
function Native.reset()
  Native.holdUse(nil, false)
  preferred, expected = nil, nil
  if restoreAim then
    restoreAim()
  end
  local snap = Native.snapshot()
  if snap then
    Native.sprint(snap, false)
  end
  lastAttack, lastUse, observed, heldTool, equippedAt = -math.huge, {}, nil, nil, -math.huge
end
function Native.teardown()
  callback = nil
  if hooked and original and hooker then
    pcall(hooker, hooked, original)
  end
  hooked, original, hooker = nil, nil, nil
  Native.reset()
end
Native.__contract = {
  provides = {
    "setup",
    "snapshot",
    "blocked",
    "find",
    "equip",
    "charge",
    "weapon",
    "restore",
    "holdUse",
    "attack",
    "use",
    "useState",
    "jump",
    "sprint",
    "gate",
    "isDispatching",
    "busy",
    "reset",
    "teardown",
  },
  requires = { Utils = "utils", Bridge = "mcpbridge", Geometry = "mcpgeometry", Inventory = "mcpinventory" },
  requiresMethods = {
    Utils = { "getLocalPlayer", "recordError" },
    Bridge = { "get" },
    Geometry = { "allowed", "eye", "stats", "direction", "melee", "blocking", "hit", "inView" },
    Inventory = { "slots", "select" },
  },
}
return Native

-- [[ mcp inventory ]]
--!optimize 2
local Inventory = {}
local utils, bridge, cachedFn, values, lease, pending
local retryAt, nextToggle = 0, 0
local controller
function Inventory.setup(deps)
  utils, bridge = deps.Utils, deps.Bridge
  local source = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("ControllerInput")
  local ok, value = pcall(function() return source and require(source) end)
  controller = ok and value or nil
  return true
end
local function owned(tool)
  local player = utils.getLocalPlayer()
  return typeof(tool) == "Instance"
    and tool:IsA("Tool")
    and (tool.Parent == player.Character or tool.Parent == player:FindFirstChild("Backpack"))
    and (tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("Count")) or 1) > 0
end
function Inventory.slots()
  local fn = bridge.get("refresh")
  if fn ~= cachedFn then
    cachedFn, values = fn, nil
  end
  if values then
    return values
  end
  local upvalues = bridge.upvalues(fn)
  if not upvalues then
    return nil
  end
  for _, value in pairs(upvalues) do
    if type(value) ~= "table" or getmetatable(value) ~= nil then
      continue
    end
    local valid, count = true, 0
    for slot, tool in pairs(value) do
      if type(slot) ~= "number" or slot % 1 ~= 0 or slot < 1 or slot > 36 or typeof(tool) ~= "Instance" or not tool:IsA("Tool") then
        valid = false
        break
      end
      count += 1
    end
    if valid and count > 0 then
      values = value
      return value
    end
  end
  return nil
end
function Inventory.find(kind, first, last)
  local slots = Inventory.slots()
  if slots then
    for slot = first or 1, last or 36 do
      local tool = slots[slot]
      if owned(tool) and tool:GetAttribute("ClassItem") == kind then
        return tool, slot
      end
    end
  end
  return nil
end
function Inventory.select(snap, slot)
  local slots, select = Inventory.slots(), bridge.get("select")
  local tool = slots and slots[slot]
  if not owned(tool) or slot < 1 or slot > 9 then
    return false
  end
  if select then
    pcall(select, slot)
  end
  snap.tool = snap.character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
  if snap.tool == tool then
    return true
  end
  if slots[slot] ~= tool or not owned(tool) then
    return false
  end
  pcall(snap.humanoid.EquipTool, snap.humanoid, tool)
  snap.tool = snap.character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
  return snap.tool == tool
end
local function visible()
  local gui = utils.getLocalPlayer():FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
  local hud = gui and gui:FindFirstChild("VoxelPackHUD")
  local panel = hud and hud:FindFirstChild("Inventory", true)
  if not panel or not panel:IsA("GuiObject") or panel.AbsoluteSize.X <= 0 or panel.AbsoluteSize.Y <= 0 then
    return false
  end
  local ancestor = panel
  while ancestor and ancestor ~= gui do
    if ancestor:IsA("GuiObject") and not ancestor.Visible or ancestor:IsA("ScreenGui") and not ancestor.Enabled then
      return false
    end
    ancestor = ancestor.Parent
  end
  return ancestor == gui
end
local function setOpen(value)
  local function matches() return visible() == value and (utils.getLocalPlayer():GetAttribute("MenuOpen") == true) == value end
  if matches() then
    return true
  end
  local fn = bridge.get("open")
  if fn then
    pcall(fn, value)
  end
  if matches() then
    return true
  end
  if controller and type(controller.BeginTouch) == "function" and type(controller.EndTouch) == "function" and os.clock() >= nextToggle then
    nextToggle = os.clock() + 0.2
    pcall(function()
      if controller.BeginTouch("Inventory") then
        controller.EndTouch("Inventory")
      end
    end)
  end
  return matches()
end
function Inventory.open(snap)
  if lease and lease.character ~= snap.character then
    Inventory.reset()
  end
  if snap.now < retryAt or not visible() and snap.player:GetAttribute("MenuOpen") then
    return false
  end
  if not lease then
    lease = { character = snap.character, owned = not visible(), frames = 0, deadline = snap.now + 3 }
  end
  lease.closeRequested = nil
  if not visible() then
    lease.frames, lease.visibleAt = 0, nil
    setOpen(true)
  end
  return visible() and snap.player:GetAttribute("MenuOpen") == true and lease.frames >= 2 and lease.visibleAt ~= nil and snap.now - lease.visibleAt >= 0.12
end
function Inventory.present()
  if lease and visible() then
    lease.frames += 1
    lease.visibleAt = lease.visibleAt or os.clock()
  end
end
function Inventory.close(force)
  if not lease then
    return true
  end
  if lease.owned then
    if not force and lease.visibleAt and os.clock() - lease.visibleAt < 0.3 then
      lease.closeRequested = true
      return false
    end
    if not setOpen(false) then
      lease.closeRequested = true
      return false
    end
  end
  lease = nil
  return true
end
function Inventory.move(snap, tool, from, to)
  local slots = Inventory.slots()
  if not slots or not owned(tool) or slots[from] ~= tool or to < 1 or to > 9 or owned(slots[to]) or not Inventory.open(snap) then
    return false
  end
  local previous = slots[to]
  slots[from], slots[to] = previous, tool
  if not pcall(cachedFn) then
    slots[from], slots[to] = tool, previous
    return false
  end
  return slots[to] == tool
end
local function restoreHand(snap, operation)
  if operation.hand and operation.previous and (not snap.tool or snap.tool == operation.tool) then
    local slots = Inventory.slots()
    for slot = 1, 9 do
      if slots and slots[slot] == operation.previous then
        Inventory.select(snap, slot)
        return
      end
    end
  end
end
function Inventory.step(snap)
  if lease then
    if lease.character ~= snap.character or snap.now >= lease.deadline then
      Inventory.close(true)
      retryAt = snap.now + 1
    elseif lease.closeRequested then
      Inventory.close()
    end
  end
  if not pending then
    return
  end
  if pending.character ~= snap.character then
    pending = nil
    return
  end
  local consumed = not owned(pending.tool) or (tonumber(pending.tool:GetAttribute("Count")) or 0) < pending.count
  local popped = snap.character:GetAttribute("TotemPoppedAt")
  local confirmed = consumed and (snap.character:GetAttribute("OffhandItem") == "totem" or popped ~= nil and popped ~= pending.pop)
    or pending.done and pending.accepted and snap.character:GetAttribute("OffhandItem") == "totem"
  if confirmed or pending.done and not pending.accepted then
    restoreHand(snap, pending)
    pending, retryAt = nil, confirmed and 0 or snap.now + 1
  elseif snap.now - pending.at >= 3 then
    if not pending.expired then
      pending.expired = true
      restoreHand(snap, pending)
      Inventory.close(true)
    end
    if pending.done then
      pending, retryAt = nil, snap.now + 1
    end
  end
end
function Inventory.totem(snap)
  Inventory.step(snap)
  if pending then
    if pending.expired then
      return nil
    end
    return false
  end
  if snap.character:GetAttribute("OffhandItem") == "totem" then
    return true
  end
  if snap.now < retryAt then
    return false
  end
  local tool, slot = Inventory.find("Totem")
  if not tool then
    return false
  end
  local previous = snap.tool
  if slot <= 9 then
    if not Inventory.select(snap, slot) then
      return false
    end
  elseif not Inventory.open(snap) then
    return false
  end
  local folder = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
  local remote = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("InventoryAction")
  if not remote then
    return false
  end
  local operation = {
    tool = tool,
    character = snap.character,
    count = tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("Count")) or 1,
    pop = snap.character:GetAttribute("TotemPoppedAt"),
    hand = slot <= 9,
    previous = previous,
    at = snap.now,
  }
  pending = operation
  task.spawn(function()
    if utils.getLocalPlayer().Character ~= operation.character or not operation.hand and not visible() then
      operation.done, operation.accepted = true, false
      return
    end
    local ok, result = pcall(remote.InvokeServer, remote, "EquipOffhand", tool)
    operation.done, operation.accepted = true, ok and result ~= nil and result ~= false
    if operation.accepted and utils.getLocalPlayer().Character == operation.character and cachedFn then
      pcall(cachedFn)
    end
  end)
  return false
end
function Inventory.busy() return lease ~= nil or pending ~= nil and pending.hand and not pending.expired end
function Inventory.reset()
  Inventory.close(true)
  if pending and pending.character ~= utils.getLocalPlayer().Character then
    pending = nil
  end
  retryAt = 0
end
function Inventory.teardown()
  Inventory.reset()
  cachedFn, values = nil, nil
end
Inventory.__contract = {
  provides = { "setup", "slots", "find", "select", "open", "present", "close", "move", "step", "totem", "busy", "reset", "teardown" },
  requires = { Utils = "utils", Bridge = "mcpbridge" },
  requiresMethods = { Utils = { "getLocalPlayer" }, Bridge = { "get", "upvalues" } },
}
return Inventory

-- [[ mcp supplies ]]
--!optimize 2
local Supplies = {}
local inventory, native, utils
local owner, layout, seen, potion, awaiting = nil, {}, {}, nil, {}
local effects = { { key = "MCAutoStrength", class = "StrengthPotion", effect = "strength" }, { key = "MCAutoSpeed", class = "SpeedPotion", effect = "speed" } }
local function enabled(key) return utils.getConfigValue(key) == true end
local function alive(tool) return tool and tool.Parent and (tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("Count")) or 1) > 0 end
local function identity(tool)
  return alive(tool) and tool.Name .. "|" .. tostring(tool:GetAttribute("ClassItem")) .. "|" .. tostring(tool:GetAttribute("BlockKey")) or nil
end
local function destination(slots, wanted)
  for slot = 1, 9 do
    if not alive(slots[slot]) and wanted and layout[slot] == wanted then
      return slot
    end
  end
  for slot = 1, 9 do
    if not alive(slots[slot]) and not layout[slot] then
      return slot
    end
  end
  return nil
end
function Supplies.setup(deps)
  inventory, native, utils = deps.Inventory, deps.Native, deps.Utils
  return true
end
function Supplies.reset()
  local snap = native.snapshot()
  if potion and snap and potion.character == snap.character then
    return
  end
  owner, layout, seen, potion, awaiting = nil, {}, {}, nil, {}
  inventory.reset()
end
function Supplies.busy() return inventory.busy() or potion ~= nil end
local function finish(snap)
  if not inventory.close() then
    return
  end
  if not native.restore(snap, potion.previous) then
    return
  end
  awaiting[potion.effect] = snap.now + (potion.confirmed and 0.5 or 1)
  potion = nil
end
local function servicePotion(snap, slots)
  if potion.character ~= snap.character then
    potion = nil
    return
  end
  if potion.phase == "confirm" then
    local state = native.useState(snap, potion, potion.effect)
    if state == nil then
      return
    end
    potion.confirmed, potion.phase = state, "cleanup"
  end
  if potion.phase == "cleanup" then
    potion.cleanupAt = potion.cleanupAt or snap.now
    if snap.now - potion.cleanupAt > 3 then
      inventory.close(true)
      native.restore(snap, potion.previous)
      awaiting[potion.effect] = snap.now + 2
      potion = nil
      return
    end
    finish(snap)
    return
  end
  local inHotbar = false
  for slot = 1, 9 do
    if slots[slot] == potion.tool then
      inHotbar = true
      break
    end
  end
  if snap.now - potion.at > 4 or not alive(potion.tool) or not inHotbar then
    potion.phase = "cleanup"
    return
  end
  if not inventory.close() or native.blocked(snap) then
    return
  end
  if native.equip(snap, potion.tool) then
    potion.count, potion.requestAt = tonumber(potion.tool:GetAttribute("Count")) or 1, snap.now
    if native.use(snap, potion.tool, Vector3.new(0, -1, 0)) then
      potion.phase = "confirm"
    end
  end
end
local function refill(snap, slots)
  for slot = 1, 9 do
    if not alive(slots[slot]) and layout[slot] then
      for from = 10, 36 do
        local tool = slots[from]
        if identity(tool) == layout[slot] then
          if not inventory.move(snap, tool, from, slot) then
            return false
          end
          break
        end
      end
    end
  end
  return true
end
local function beginPotion(snap, slots, effect, tool)
  potion = {
    character = snap.character,
    tool = tool,
    effect = effect.effect,
    previous = snap.tool,
    at = snap.now,
    phase = "use",
  }
  servicePotion(snap, slots)
  return true
end
function Supplies.step(snap, allowBackground)
  if owner ~= snap.character then
    owner, layout, seen, potion, awaiting = snap.character, {}, {}, nil, {}
    inventory.reset()
  end
  inventory.step(snap)
  local slots = inventory.slots()
  if not slots then
    if potion and snap.now - potion.at > 4 then
      inventory.close(true)
      native.restore(snap, potion.previous)
      potion = nil
    end
    return
  end
  if potion then
    servicePotion(snap, slots)
    return
  end
  if allowBackground == false and not inventory.busy() or snap.character:GetAttribute("EatingApple") then
    return
  end
  for slot = 1, 9 do
    local tool = slots[slot]
    if alive(tool) then
      layout[slot] = identity(tool)
    elseif alive(seen[slot]) then
      layout[slot] = nil
    end
    seen[slot] = alive(tool) and tool or nil
  end
  if enabled("MCAutoTotem") and snap.character:GetAttribute("OffhandItem") ~= "totem" and inventory.find("Totem") then
    if inventory.totem(snap) == false then
      return
    end
  end
  if enabled("MCAutoRefill") and not refill(snap, slots) then
    return
  end
  if allowBackground ~= false and enabled("MCAutoPotion") then
    for _, effect in ipairs(effects) do
      if
        enabled(effect.key)
        and snap.now >= (awaiting[effect.effect] or 0)
        and (tonumber(snap.character:GetAttribute("Effect_" .. effect.effect)) or 0) <= workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
      then
        local tool = inventory.find(effect.class, 1, 9)
        if tool and beginPotion(snap, slots, effect, tool) then
          return
        end
      end
    end
  end
  if enabled("MCAutoTotem") and snap.character:GetAttribute("OffhandItem") == "totem" and not inventory.find("Totem", 1, 9) then
    local tool, from = inventory.find("Totem", 10, 36)
    local to = tool and destination(slots, identity(tool))
    if to and not inventory.move(snap, tool, from, to) then
      return
    end
  end
  inventory.close()
end
Supplies.__contract = {
  provides = { "setup", "reset", "step", "busy" },
  requires = { Inventory = "mcpinventory", Native = "mcpnative", Utils = "utils" },
  requiresMethods = {
    Inventory = { "slots", "find", "move", "close", "totem", "step", "busy", "reset" },
    Native = { "snapshot", "equip", "restore", "use", "useState", "blocked" },
    Utils = { "getConfigValue" },
  },
}
return Supplies

-- [[ mcp survival ]]
--!optimize 2
local Survival = {}
local native, geometry, target, pearl, inventory, units, utils
local owner, apple, escape, routeJob, walking
local health, damage, interval, hurtAt, hits = nil, 0, 0.6, nil, 0
local nextApple, nextRoute, episode = 0, 0, false
local generation, eatingDuration = 0, 1.6
local FLAT = Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
function Survival.setup(deps)
  native, geometry, target, pearl, inventory, units, utils = deps.Native, deps.Geometry, deps.Target, deps.Pearl, deps.Inventory, deps.Units, deps.Utils
  return true
end
local function stopWalking(snap)
  if not walking then
    return
  end
  walking = nil
  if snap then
    snap.humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
  end
end
function Survival.reset()
  local snap = native.snapshot()
  if apple and snap and owner == snap.character and snap.character:GetAttribute("EatingApple") then
    escape, routeJob, episode = nil, nil, true
    generation += 1
    stopWalking(snap)
    return
  end
  native.holdUse(nil, false)
  stopWalking(snap)
  owner, apple, escape, routeJob, health = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
  damage, interval, hurtAt, hits, nextApple, nextRoute, episode = 0, 0.6, nil, 0, 0, 0, false
  generation += 1
end
function Survival.busy() return apple ~= nil or escape ~= nil end
local function findApple()
  local slots = inventory.slots()
  for slot = 1, 9 do
    local tool = slots and slots[slot]
    if tool and tool.Parent and tool.Name == "Gold Apple" and (tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("Count")) or 1) > 0 then
      return tool
    end
  end
  return nil
end
local function finishApple(snap, completed)
  native.holdUse(nil, false)
  apple.finishedAt = apple.finishedAt or snap.now
  if not native.restore(snap, apple.previous) and snap.now - apple.finishedAt < 1 then
    return false
  end
  apple, nextApple = nil, snap.now + (completed and eatingDuration or 0.8)
  if escape then
    escape.fed = completed == true
    if completed then
      escape.progressAt = snap.now
    end
  end
  return true
end
local function eat(snap)
  if not apple then
    return false
  end
  local tool = apple.tool
  local consumed = not tool.Parent or (tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("Count")) or apple.count) < apple.count
  if consumed then
    finishApple(snap, true)
    return true
  end
  if apple.started then
    local untilAt = tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("EatingUntil")) or 0
    local since = tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("EatingStarted")) or 0
    local duration = tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("EatingDuration")) or untilAt - since
    if duration > 0 and duration < 10 then
      eatingDuration = duration
    end
    local serverNow = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
    local active = untilAt > serverNow or snap.character:GetAttribute("EatingApple") == true
    local expired = untilAt > 0 and serverNow > untilAt + 0.5 or untilAt <= 0 and snap.now - apple.started > math.max(3, eatingDuration + 1)
    if active and not expired then
      apple.ack = true
      if escape then
        escape.progressAt = snap.now
      end
      return true
    end
    if active and expired then
      finishApple(snap)
      return true
    end
    if snap.tool ~= tool or apple.ack or snap.now - apple.started > 2.5 then
      finishApple(snap)
    end
    return true
  end
  if snap.now > apple.deadline then
    finishApple(snap)
  elseif native.equip(snap, tool) and native.holdUse(snap, true) then
    apple.started = snap.now
  end
  return true
end
local function beginApple(snap)
  if apple or snap.now < nextApple or native.blocked(snap) then
    return false
  end
  local tool = findApple()
  if not tool then
    return false
  end
  apple = { tool = tool, previous = snap.tool, count = tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("Count")) or 1, deadline = snap.now + 1 }
  return eat(snap)
end
local function rayParams(snap)
  local ray = RaycastParams.new()
  local ignored = { snap.character, snap.camera }
  for _, player in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
    if player.Character then
      ignored[#ignored + 1] = player.Character
    end
  end
  ray.FilterType, ray.RespectCanCollide, ray.FilterDescendantsInstances = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude, true, ignored
  return ray
end
local function away(snap)
  local source = escape and escape.foe
  if source and source.Parent then
    escape.position = source.Position
  end
  local direction = escape and escape.position and (snap.root.Position - escape.position) * FLAT or -snap.camera.CFrame.LookVector * FLAT
  return direction.Magnitude > 0.001 and direction.Unit or Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
end
local function turn(direction, angle)
  local sine, cosine = math.sin(math.rad(angle)), math.cos(math.rad(angle))
  return Vector3.new(direction.X * cosine - direction.Z * sine, 0, direction.X * sine + direction.Z * cosine)
end
local ESCAPE_DISTANCES, ESCAPE_ANGLES = { 24, 18, 12, 8, 4, 2 }, { 0, 35, -35, 70, -70, 110, -110, 180 }
local function escapeRoute(snap)
  local origin = units.toBlocks(snap.root.Position)
  if not escape.search or (escape.search.origin - origin).Magnitude > 0.5 then
    escape.search = { origin = origin, direction = away(snap), index = 1 }
  end
  local search = escape.search
  local threat = escape.position and units.toBlocks(escape.position)
  for _ = 1, 4 do
    local distance = ESCAPE_DISTANCES[math.floor((search.index - 1) / #ESCAPE_ANGLES) + 1]
    if not distance then
      escape.search = nil
      return nil, false
    end
    local angle = ESCAPE_ANGLES[(search.index - 1) % #ESCAPE_ANGLES + 1]
    search.index += 1
    local route = pearl.route(snap, origin + turn(search.direction, angle) * distance, true)
    if route and (not threat or (route.landing - threat).Magnitude > (origin - threat).Magnitude + 1) then
      escape.search = nil
      return route, false
    end
  end
  return nil, true
end
local function requestWalk(snap)
  if routeJob or walking then
    return
  end
  local token, character, origin, direction = generation, snap.character, snap.root.Position, away(snap)
  routeJob = token
  task.spawn(function()
    local success, reason = pcall(function()
      local ray = rayParams(snap)
      local pathService = game:GetService("PathfindingService")
      for _, angle in ipairs({ 0, 60, -60, 120, -120, 180 }) do
        if token ~= generation then
          return
        end
        local destination = origin + units.toWorld(turn(direction, angle) * 5)
        local floor = workspace:Raycast(destination + units.offset(0, 6, 0), units.offset(0, -12, 0), ray)
        local key = floor and floor.Instance:GetAttribute("BlockKey")
        if not floor or floor.Normal.Y < 0.65 or floor.Material == Enum.Material.Water or key == "lava" or key == "water" then
          continue
        end
        if workspace:Raycast(floor.Position + units.offset(0, 1 / 64, 0), units.offset(0, 2, 0), ray) then
          continue
        end
        local path = pathService:CreatePath({
          AgentRadius = units.toWorld(0.28),
          AgentHeight = units.toWorld(1.96),
          AgentCanJump = true,
          AgentJumpHeight = units.toWorld(1.25),
          WaypointSpacing = units.toWorld(0.75),
        })
        local ok = pcall(path.ComputeAsync, path, origin, floor.Position + units.offset(0, 1.25, 0))
        if token ~= generation then
          return
        end
        if ok and path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
          local points = path:GetWaypoints()
          if #points > 1 then
            walking = { character = character, points = points, index = 2, at = os.clock(), position = origin, progress = os.clock() }
            break
          end
        end
      end
    end)
    if token == generation then
      routeJob = nil
      if not success then
        utils.recordError("mcpvp.escape.path", tostring(reason))
      end
    end
  end)
end
function Survival.move(snap)
  if not walking or not escape or walking.character ~= snap.character then
    return
  end
  local point = walking.points[walking.index]
  if not point or snap.now - walking.at > 5 then
    stopWalking(snap)
    return
  end
  if units.distance(snap.root.Position, walking.position) > 0.3 then
    walking.position, walking.progress = snap.root.Position, snap.now
  end
  if snap.now - walking.progress > 0.8 then
    stopWalking(snap)
    return
  end
  local delta = (point.Position - snap.root.Position) * FLAT
  if units.toBlocks(delta.Magnitude) < 0.5 then
    walking.index += 1
    return
  end
  snap.humanoid:Move(delta.Unit, false)
  if point.Action == Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump and geometry.grounded(snap) and geometry.headroom(snap) and not geometry.jumpRisk(snap) then
    native.jump(snap)
  end
end
local function observeHealth(snap)
  if health and snap.humanoid.Health < health then
    local loss = health - snap.humanoid.Health
    if hurtAt and snap.now - hurtAt >= 0.15 and snap.now - hurtAt <= 3 then
      interval = interval * 0.5 + (snap.now - hurtAt) * 0.5
      hits += 1
    else
      hits = 1
    end
    damage = damage > 0 and damage * 0.5 + loss * 0.5 or loss
    hurtAt = snap.now
    if not escape then
      episode = false
    end
  end
  health = snap.humanoid.Health
end
local function appleDue(snap, value)
  if not value or hits < 2 or not hurtAt or snap.now - hurtAt > 3 or damage <= 0 then
    return false
  end
  if geometry.stats(value.character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")).type ~= "sword" then
    return false
  end
  local absorption = tonumber(snap.character:GetAttribute("Absorption")) or tonumber(snap.player:GetAttribute("Absorption")) or 0
  local hitsLeft = math.max(1, math.ceil((snap.humanoid.Health + absorption) / damage))
  local nextHit = math.max(0, interval - (snap.now - hurtAt))
  local timeToPop = nextHit + (hitsLeft - 1) * interval
  local tool = findApple()
  local duration = tool and tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("EatingDuration")) or eatingDuration
  return timeToPop <= duration + 0.2
end
function Survival.step(snap, available)
  if owner ~= snap.character then
    Survival.reset()
    owner = snap.character
  end
  observeHealth(snap)
  if escape and escape.foe and escape.foe.Parent then
    escape.position = escape.foe.Position
  end
  if apple then
    eat(snap)
    return true
  end
  if utils.getConfigValue("MCAutoEscape") ~= true then
    if escape or routeJob or walking then
      escape, routeJob = nil, nil
      generation += 1
      stopWalking(snap)
    end
    return false
  end
  local hasTotem = snap.character:GetAttribute("OffhandItem") == "totem" or native.find(snap, "Totem") ~= nil
  if hasTotem or snap.humanoid.Health > snap.humanoid.MaxHealth * 0.6 then
    episode = false
  end
  local value = target.current(snap)
  local threat = value or target.threat(snap)
  if not escape and not episode and threat and not hasTotem and snap.humanoid.Health <= snap.humanoid.MaxHealth * 0.5 then
    escape = {
      foe = threat and threat.root,
      position = threat and threat.root.Position,
      origin = snap.root.Position,
      progressPosition = snap.root.Position,
      progressAt = snap.now,
      fed = false,
    }
    pearl.cancelPrepared(snap)
    target.abandon(snap)
    generation += 1
  end
  if not escape then
    if available and not pearl.busy() and hasTotem and appleDue(snap, value) then
      return beginApple(snap)
    end
    return false
  end
  if units.distance(snap.root.Position, escape.progressPosition) >= 0.5 or pearl.escaping() then
    escape.progressPosition, escape.progressAt = snap.root.Position, snap.now
  end
  if snap.now - escape.progressAt >= 3 and not pearl.busy() then
    escape, routeJob, episode = nil, nil, true
    generation += 1
    stopWalking(snap)
    return false
  end
  if not available then
    return true
  end
  if pearl.busy() then
    pearl.advance(snap)
    return true
  end
  if pearl.escaping() then
    escape.launched = true
  end
  if (escape.launched or pearl.pending() or not native.find(snap, "Pearl", true)) and not escape.fed then
    if beginApple(snap) then
      return true
    end
    if not findApple() then
      escape.fed = true
    end
  end
  if (escape.search or snap.now >= nextRoute) and not pearl.pending() and not escape.launched then
    nextRoute = snap.now + 0.5
    local route, searching
    if native.find(snap, "Pearl", true) then
      route, searching = escapeRoute(snap)
    end
    if route then
      stopWalking(snap)
      pearl.launch(snap, route, true)
    elseif not searching then
      requestWalk(snap)
      if not escape.fed and beginApple(snap) then
        return true
      end
    end
  end
  local far = escape.position and units.distance(snap.root.Position, escape.position) >= 12
  local moved = units.distance(snap.root.Position, escape.origin) >= 8
  if escape.fed and (far or not escape.position and moved or snap.humanoid.Health > snap.humanoid.MaxHealth * 0.6 or hasTotem) then
    escape, episode, routeJob = nil, true, nil
    generation += 1
    stopWalking(snap)
    return false
  end
  if escape.launched and not pearl.pending() and not far and (escape.position or not moved) then
    escape.launched = false
  end
  Survival.move(snap)
  return true
end
Survival.__contract = {
  provides = { "setup", "reset", "busy", "step", "move" },
  requires = {
    Native = "mcpnative",
    Geometry = "mcpgeometry",
    Target = "mcptarget",
    Pearl = "autopearl",
    Inventory = "mcpinventory",
    Units = "mcpunits",
    Utils = "utils",
  },
  requiresMethods = {
    Native = { "snapshot", "restore", "equip", "holdUse", "blocked", "find", "jump" },
    Geometry = { "stats", "grounded", "headroom", "jumpRisk" },
    Target = { "current", "threat", "abandon" },
    Pearl = { "route", "launch", "advance", "busy", "pending", "escaping", "cancelPrepared" },
    Inventory = { "slots" },
    Units = { "toBlocks", "toWorld", "offset", "distance" },
    Utils = { "getConfigValue", "recordError" },
  },
}
return Survival

-- [[ mm2 farm ]]
--!optimize 2

local Farm = {}
local State, World, Movement, Utils
local target, startedAt, nextPick = nil, 0, 0
local ignored = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
function Farm.setup(deps)
  State, World, Movement, Utils = deps.State, deps.World, deps.Movement, deps.Utils
  return true
end
function Farm.reset()
  target, nextPick = nil, 0
  ignored = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
  Movement.cancel("farm")
end
function Farm.step(snap)
  if not Utils.getConfigValue("MM2AutoFarm") or not snap or State.full() then
    Farm.reset()
    if snap and State.full() and snap.role == "Innocent" and Utils.getConfigValue("MM2ResetFull") then
      snap.humanoid.Health = 0
    end
    return
  end
  local owner = Movement.owner()
  if owner and owner ~= "farm" then
    return
  end
  local now = os.clock()
  if target and (not World.collectable(target) or now - startedAt > 8) then
    ignored[target] = now + 4
    target = nil
    Movement.cancel("farm")
  end
  if not target then
    if now < nextPick then
      return
    end
    nextPick = now + 0.35
    local murderer = Utils.getConfigValue("MM2AvoidMurderer") and State.findRole("Murderer")
    target = World.nearest(
      snap.root.Position,
      World.coins(),
      function(coin)
        return (ignored[coin] or 0) <= now and World.collectable(coin) and (not murderer or (coin.Position - murderer.root.Position).Magnitude >= 18)
      end
    )
    startedAt = now
  end
  if target then
    Movement.walk(snap, target.Position, "farm", Utils.getConfigValue("MM2FarmSpeed"))
  end
end
Farm.__contract = {
  provides = { "setup", "reset", "step" },
  requires = { State = "mm2state", World = "mm2world", Movement = "mm2movement", Utils = "utils" },
  requiresMethods = {
    State = { "full", "findRole" },
    World = { "collectable", "nearest", "coins" },
    Movement = { "owner", "walk", "cancel" },
    Utils = { "getConfigValue" },
  },
}
return Farm

-- [[ mm2 pickup ]]
--!optimize 2

local Pickup = {}
local State, World, Movement, Utils
local nextTeleport = 0
function Pickup.setup(deps)
  State, World, Movement, Utils = deps.State, deps.World, deps.Movement, deps.Utils
  return true
end
function Pickup.reset()
  nextTeleport = 0
  Movement.cancel("pickup")
end
function Pickup.step(snap)
  if
    not snap
    or snap.role == "Murderer"
    or State.tool(snap, "Gun", false)
    or not Utils.getConfigValue("MM2AutoPickup") and not Utils.getConfigValue("MM2TeleportGun")
  then
    Pickup.reset()
    return false
  end
  if Movement.owner() == "manual" then
    return false
  end
  local map = State.map()
  local _, point = World.nearest(snap.root.Position, World.guns(), function(object) return map ~= nil and object:IsDescendantOf(map) end)
  if not point then
    Pickup.reset()
    return false
  end
  local murderer = Utils.getConfigValue("MM2PickupSafety") and State.findRole("Murderer")
  if murderer and ((murderer.root.Position - point).Magnitude < 20 or (murderer.root.Position - snap.root.Position).Magnitude < 12) then
    Pickup.reset()
    return false
  end
  if Utils.getConfigValue("MM2TeleportGun") then
    if os.clock() >= nextTeleport then
      nextTeleport = os.clock() + 1
      Movement.teleport(snap, point + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0))
    end
  else
    Movement.walk(snap, point, "pickup")
  end
  return true
end
Pickup.__contract = {
  provides = { "setup", "reset", "step" },
  requires = { State = "mm2state", World = "mm2world", Movement = "mm2movement", Utils = "utils" },
  requiresMethods = {
    State = { "map", "tool", "findRole" },
    World = { "nearest", "guns" },
    Movement = { "cancel", "owner", "teleport", "walk" },
    Utils = { "getConfigValue" },
  },
}
return Pickup

-- [[ mm2 targeting ]]
--!optimize 2

local Targeting = {}
local State
local Collection = game:GetService("CollectionService")
function Targeting.setup(deps)
  State = deps.State
  return true
end
function Targeting.clear(snap, target, origin, point)
  local delta = point - origin
  if delta.Magnitude < 0.01 then
    return false
  end
  local parameters = RaycastParams.new()
  parameters.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
  local ignored = { snap.character }
  for _, object in ipairs(Collection:GetTagged("WeaponPassthrough")) do
    ignored[#ignored + 1] = object
  end
  parameters.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignored
  local hit = workspace:Raycast(origin, delta, parameters)
  return not hit or hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(target.character)
end
function Targeting.select(snap, mode, maxDistance, aimAngle)
  local best, distance, rank = nil, maxDistance or math.huge, math.huge
  local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
  if mode == "Aim" and not camera then
    return nil
  end
  local limit = math.cos(math.rad(math.clamp(tonumber(aimAngle) or 60, 10, 90)))
  for _, player in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
    if player == snap.player then
      continue
    end
    local candidate = State.live(player, true)
    if not candidate then
      continue
    end
    local armed = candidate.role == "Sheriff" or candidate.role == "Hero" or State.tool(candidate, "Gun", false) ~= nil
    if mode == "Sheriff/Hero" and not armed or mode == "Innocent" and candidate.role ~= "Innocent" then
      continue
    end
    local delta = (snap.root.Position - candidate.root.Position).Magnitude
    local priority = mode == "Auto" and (armed and 0 or 1) or 0
    if mode == "Aim" then
      local offset = candidate.root.Position - camera.CFrame.Position
      if offset.Magnitude < 0.01 then
        continue
      end
      local alignment = camera.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(offset.Unit)
      if alignment < limit then
        continue
      end
      priority = 1 - alignment
    elseif mode == "Random" then
      priority = math.random()
    end
    if delta <= (maxDistance or math.huge) and (priority < rank or priority == rank and delta < distance) then
      if Targeting.clear(snap, candidate, snap.root.Position, candidate.root.Position) then
        best, distance, rank = candidate, delta, priority
      end
    end
  end
  return best
end
function Targeting.predict(origin, target, speed)
  local lead = math.clamp((target.root.Position - origin).Magnitude / math.max(speed, 1), 0, 1)
  return target.root.Position + target.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity * lead
end

  provides = { "setup", "clear", "select", "predict" },
  requires = { State = "mm2state" },
  requiresMethods = { State = { "live", "tool" } },
}

-- [[ mm2 weapons ]]
--!optimize 2

local Weapons = {}
local State, Targeting, Utils, Native
local lastShot, lastStab, lastThrow, equipped, equippedAt = -math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge, nil, 0
local random = Random.new()
function Weapons.setup(deps)
  State, Targeting, Utils, Native = deps.State, deps.Targeting, deps.Utils, deps.Native
  return true
end
function Weapons.reset()
  Native.reset()
  equipped, equippedAt = nil, 0
  lastShot, lastStab, lastThrow = -math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge
end
local function equip(snap, name)
  local tool = State.tool(snap, name, true)
  if tool ~= equipped then
    equipped, equippedAt = tool, os.clock()
    return
  end
  if not tool or tool.Parent ~= snap.character or os.clock() - equippedAt < 0.2 then
    return
  end
  return tool
end
local function event(parent, name)
  local object = parent and parent:FindFirstChild(name)
  return object and object:IsA("RemoteEvent") and object
end
function Weapons.shoot(automatic)
  local now = os.clock()
  if not Utils.isActive() or now - lastShot < 3.1 then
    return false
  end
  local snap = State.live(Utils.getLocalPlayer(), true)
  local target = State.findRole("Murderer")
  if not snap or not target or target.player == snap.player or snap.role == "Murderer" then
    return false
  end
  if Utils.getConfigValue("MM2LegitSheriff") and not target.character:FindFirstChild("Knife") then
    return false
  end
  local gun = equip(snap, "Gun")
  if not gun then
    return false
  end
  local shoot = event(gun, "Shoot")
  if not shoot then
    return false
  end
  local attachment = snap.root:FindFirstChild("GunRaycastAttachment") or gun:FindFirstChild("GunRaycastAttachment", true)
  local handle = gun:FindFirstChild("Handle")
  local origin = attachment and attachment:IsA("Attachment") and attachment.WorldPosition
    or handle and handle:IsA("BasePart") and handle.Position
    or snap.root.Position
  local point = Targeting.predict(origin, target, 1200)
  if not Targeting.clear(snap, target, origin, point) then
    return false
  end
  local accuracy = math.clamp(tonumber(Utils.getConfigValue(automatic and "MM2AutoAccuracy" or "MM2ManualAccuracy")) or 100, 0, 100)
  if random:NextNumber(0, 100) > accuracy then
    point += Vector3.new(random:NextNumber(5, 9), random:NextNumber(4, 7), 0)
  end
  lastShot = now
  shoot:FireServer(origin, CFrame.new(point))
  return true
end
function Weapons.throw(automatic)
  if not Utils.isActive() or Native.busy() then
    return false
  end
  local snap = State.live(Utils.getLocalPlayer(), true)
  if not snap or snap.role ~= "Murderer" or snap.character:GetAttribute("Zombie") == true then
    return false
  end
  local knife = equip(snap, "Knife")
  if not knife then
    return false
  end
  local now = os.clock()
  local charge = math.clamp(tonumber(knife:GetAttribute("ThrowSpeed")) or 0.5, 0.05, 3)
  if now - lastThrow < charge * 2 or now - lastStab < 0.4 then
    return false
  end
  local target = Targeting.select(snap, Utils.getConfigValue(automatic and "MM2ThrowTargets" or "MM2ManualThrowTargets") or "Aim", 250, Utils.getConfigValue(automatic and "MM2ThrowFOV" or "MM2ManualThrowFOV"))
  local handle = knife:FindFirstChild("Handle")
  if not target or not handle or not handle:IsA("BasePart") then
    return false
  end
  local point = Targeting.predict(handle.Position, target, 100)
  if not Targeting.clear(snap, target, handle.Position, point) then
    return false
  end
  local accepted, reason = Native.throw(snap, knife, CFrame.new(point), function()
    local live = State.live(target.player, true)
    return (not automatic or Utils.getConfigValue("MM2AutoThrow")) and live ~= nil and live.character == target.character
  end)
  if accepted then
    lastThrow = now
  end
  return accepted, reason
end
function Weapons.step()
  Native.step()
  if Native.busy() then
    return
  end
  if Utils.getConfigValue("MM2ManualShoot") then
    local snap = State.live(Utils.getLocalPlayer(), true)
    if snap and snap.role ~= "Murderer" and State.tool(snap, "Gun", false) then
      equip(snap, "Gun")
    end
  end
  if Utils.getConfigValue("MM2AutoShoot") then
    Weapons.shoot(true)
  end
  local snap = State.live(Utils.getLocalPlayer(), true)
  if not snap or snap.role ~= "Murderer" then
    return
  end
  if not Utils.getConfigValue("MM2AutoStab") and not Utils.getConfigValue("MM2AutoThrow") and not Utils.getConfigValue("MM2ManualThrow") then
    return
  end
  local knife = equip(snap, "Knife")
  if not knife then
    return
  end
  local now = os.clock()
  local charge = math.clamp(tonumber(knife:GetAttribute("ThrowSpeed")) or 0.5, 0.05, 3)
  if Utils.getConfigValue("MM2AutoStab") and now - lastStab >= 0.85 and now - lastThrow >= charge * 2 then
    local target = Targeting.select(snap, Utils.getConfigValue("MM2StabTargets"), 6)
    if target then
      local accepted = Native.stab(snap, knife, function()
        local live = State.live(target.player, true)
        return Utils.getConfigValue("MM2AutoStab") and live ~= nil and live.character == target.character
      end)
      if accepted then
        lastStab = now
        return
      end
    end
  end
  if Utils.getConfigValue("MM2AutoThrow") then
    Weapons.throw(true)
  end
end
Weapons.__contract = {
  provides = { "setup", "reset", "shoot", "throw", "step" },
  requires = { State = "mm2state", Targeting = "mm2targeting", Utils = "utils", Native = "mm2native" },
  requiresMethods = {
    State = { "live", "findRole", "tool" },
    Native = { "reset", "busy", "stab", "throw", "step" },
    Targeting = { "clear", "select", "predict" },
    Utils = { "isActive", "getConfigValue", "getLocalPlayer" },
  },
}
return Weapons

-- [[ mm2 alerts ]]
--!optimize 2

local Alerts = {}
local State, World, Utils
local lastMap, signature, seen, notify = nil, nil, {}, nil
function Alerts.setup(deps)
  State, World, Utils = deps.State, deps.World, deps.Utils
  return true
end
function Alerts.bind(callback)
  notify = callback
  Alerts.reset()
end
function Alerts.reset()
  lastMap, signature, seen = nil, nil, {}
end
function Alerts.step()
  local map = State.map()
  if lastMap ~= map then
    lastMap, signature, seen = map, nil, {}
  end
  if not map then
    return
  end
  local snap = State.live(Utils.getLocalPlayer(), true)
  local murderer = State.findRole("Murderer")
  if snap and murderer and Utils.getConfigValue("MM2AlertRoles") then
    local nextSignature = tostring(snap.role) .. "|" .. murderer.player.Name
    if
      nextSignature ~= signature
      and notify("Papéis da rodada", "Seu cargo: " .. tostring(snap.role) .. " · Assassino: " .. murderer.player.DisplayName, { id = "mm2-roles" })
    then
      signature = nextSignature
    end
  end
  for gun in pairs(seen) do
    if not World.guns()[gun] then
      seen[gun] = nil
    end
  end
  for gun in pairs(World.guns()) do
    if not seen[gun] and gun:IsDescendantOf(map) then
      if not Utils.getConfigValue("MM2AlertGun") or notify("Arma caiu", "Uma arma está disponível no mapa.", { id = "mm2-gun", kind = "warning" }) then
        seen[gun] = true
      end
    end
  end
end
Alerts.__contract = {
  provides = { "setup", "bind", "reset", "step" },
  requires = { State = "mm2state", World = "mm2world", Utils = "utils" },
  requiresMethods = { State = { "map", "live", "findRole" }, World = { "guns" }, Utils = { "getConfigValue", "getLocalPlayer" } },
}
return Alerts

-- [[ mm2 map tools ]]
--!optimize 2

local MapTools = {}
local State, World, Movement, Utils
local manualUntil, nextVote = 0, 0
function MapTools.setup(deps)
  State, World, Movement, Utils = deps.State, deps.World, deps.Movement, deps.Utils
  return true
end
function MapTools.reset()
  manualUntil, nextVote = 0, 0
  Movement.cancel("manual")
  Movement.cancel("vote")
end
local function localSnap() return State.live(Utils.getLocalPlayer(), State.map() ~= nil) end
local function move(point, walking)
  local snap = localSnap()
  if not snap or not point then
    return false, "Destino ou personagem indisponível."
  end
  manualUntil = os.clock() + 12
  if walking then
    return Movement.walk(snap, point, "manual")
  end
  return Movement.teleport(snap, point)
end
function MapTools.map()
  local map = State.map()
  local spawns = map and map:FindFirstChild("Spawns")
  local spawn = spawns and spawns:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
  return move(spawn and spawn.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
end
function MapTools.lobby()
  local lobby = workspace:FindFirstChild("RegularLobby")
  local spawn
  for _, name in ipairs({ "Spawn", "SpawnLocation", "LobbySpawn" }) do
    local candidate = lobby and lobby:FindFirstChild(name, true)
    if candidate and candidate:IsA("BasePart") then
      spawn = candidate
      break
    end
  end
  spawn = spawn or lobby and lobby:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpawnLocation", true)
  return move(spawn and spawn.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
end
function MapTools.role(role)
  local target = State.findRole(role)
  return move(target and target.root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0, 3))
end
function MapTools.gun()
  local snap = localSnap()
  local map = State.map()
  local _, point = World.nearest(snap and snap.root.Position or Vector3.zero, World.guns(), function(object) return map and object:IsDescendantOf(map) end)
  return move(point and point + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0))
end
function MapTools.holder()
  for _, player in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
    local snap = State.live(player, true)
    if snap and player ~= Utils.getLocalPlayer() and State.tool(snap, "Gun", false) then
      return move(snap.root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0, 3))
    end
  end
  return false, "Nenhum portador de arma disponível."
end
function MapTools.player(walking)
  local player = game:GetService("Players"):FindFirstChild(Utils.getConfigValue("MM2TargetPlayer") or "")
  local target = player ~= Utils.getLocalPlayer() and State.live(player, State.map() ~= nil)
  return move(target and target.root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0, 3), walking)
end
function MapTools.players()
  local choices = { "None" }
  for _, player in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
    if player ~= Utils.getLocalPlayer() then
      choices[#choices + 1] = player.Name
    end
  end
  table.sort(choices)
  return choices
end
local function board()
  local lobby = workspace:FindFirstChild("RegularLobby")
  local pads = lobby and lobby:FindFirstChild("VotePads")
  local entries = {}
  for index = 1, 3 do
    local pad = lobby and lobby:FindFirstChild("VotePad" .. index)
    local detector = pads and pads:FindFirstChild("Detector" .. index)
    if pad and detector and detector:IsA("BasePart") then
      local label = pad:FindFirstChild("MapName", true)
      if label and label:IsA("TextLabel") and label.Text ~= "" and label.Text ~= "MAP NAME" then
        entries[#entries + 1] = { name = label.Text, point = detector.Position }
      end
    end
  end
  return entries
end
function MapTools.maps()
  local choices = { "None" }
  local sync = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Database")
  sync = sync and sync:FindFirstChild("Sync")
  local maps = sync and sync:FindFirstChild("Maps")
  if maps and maps:IsA("ModuleScript") then
    local ok, result = pcall(require, maps)
    if ok and type(result) == "table" then
      for name in pairs(result) do
        if type(name) == "string" then
          choices[#choices + 1] = name
        end
      end
    end
  end
  if #choices == 1 then
    for _, entry in ipairs(board()) do
      choices[#choices + 1] = entry.name
    end
  end
  return choices
end
function MapTools.step()
  if os.clock() < nextVote then
    return
  end
  nextVote = os.clock() + 2
  local favorite = Utils.getConfigValue("MM2FavoriteMap")
  if State.map() or os.clock() < manualUntil or not favorite or favorite == "None" then
    Movement.cancel("vote")
    return
  end
  local normalize = function(value) return string.lower(value):gsub("[%s_%-]", "") end
  for _, entry in ipairs(board()) do
    if normalize(entry.name) == normalize(favorite) then
      local snap = localSnap()
      if snap and (snap.root.Position - entry.point).Magnitude > 3 and not Movement.busy() then
        Movement.walk(snap, entry.point, "vote")
      end
      return
    end
  end
end
MapTools.__contract = {
  provides = { "setup", "reset", "map", "lobby", "role", "gun", "holder", "player", "players", "maps", "step" },
  requires = { State = "mm2state", World = "mm2world", Movement = "mm2movement", Utils = "utils" },
  requiresMethods = {
    State = { "live", "map", "findRole", "tool" },
    World = { "nearest", "guns" },
    Movement = { "walk", "teleport", "cancel", "busy" },
    Utils = { "getLocalPlayer", "getConfigValue" },
  },
}
return MapTools

-- [[ mm2 movement ]]
--!optimize 2

local Movement = {}
local Pathfinding = game:GetService("PathfindingService")
local scope, job, serial = nil, nil, 0
local nextPlan = 0
function Movement.setup() return true end
function Movement.cancel(owner)
  if not job or owner and job.owner ~= owner then
    return
  end
  local old = job
  job = nil
  serial += 1
  old.scope.destroy()
end
function Movement.teardown()
  Movement.cancel()
  scope = nil
  nextPlan = 0
end
function Movement.bind(lifetime)
  Movement.teardown()
  scope = lifetime.child()
end
function Movement.busy() return job ~= nil end
function Movement.owner() return job and job.owner end
function Movement.walk(snap, destination, owner, speed)
  if not scope or not scope.alive or not destination then
    return false
  end
  if job and job.owner == owner and job.character == snap.character and (job.destination - destination).Magnitude < 4 then
    return true
  end
  if not job and os.clock() < nextPlan then
    return false
  end
  Movement.cancel()
  nextPlan = os.clock() + 0.75
  serial += 1
  local generation = serial
  local lifetime = scope.child()
  local original, applied = snap.humanoid.WalkSpeed, math.clamp(tonumber(speed) or snap.humanoid.WalkSpeed, 5, 100)
  job = { owner = owner, character = snap.character, destination = destination, scope = lifetime, deadline = os.clock() + 12 }
  snap.humanoid.WalkSpeed = applied
  lifetime.add(function()
    if snap.humanoid.Parent then
      snap.humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero)
      if snap.humanoid.WalkSpeed == applied then
        snap.humanoid.WalkSpeed = original
      end
    end
  end)
  local thread = task.defer(function()
    local path = Pathfinding:CreatePath({ AgentRadius = 2, AgentHeight = 5, AgentCanJump = true, WaypointSpacing = 4 })
    lifetime.add(function() path:Destroy() end)
    local ok = pcall(function() path:ComputeAsync(snap.root.Position, destination) end)
    if not lifetime.alive or serial ~= generation then
      return
    end
    if not ok or path.Status ~= Enum.PathStatus.Success then
      job = nil
      lifetime.destroy()
      return
    end
    local waypoints, index = path:GetWaypoints(), 2
    local function advance(reached)
      if serial ~= generation or not lifetime.alive then
        return
      end
      if not reached or not waypoints[index] or snap.humanoid.Health <= 0 then
        job = nil
        lifetime.destroy()
        return
      end
      local waypoint = waypoints[index]
      index += 1
      if waypoint.Action == Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump then
        snap.humanoid.Jump = true
      end
      snap.humanoid:MoveTo(waypoint.Position)
    end
    lifetime.connect(snap.humanoid.MoveToFinished, advance)
    lifetime.connect(path.Blocked, function(blocked)
      if blocked >= index - 1 then
        Movement.cancel(owner)
      end
    end)
    advance(true)
  end)
  lifetime.add(thread, function() pcall(task.cancel, thread) end)
  return true
end
function Movement.step()
  if job and (not job.character.Parent or os.clock() > job.deadline) then
    Movement.cancel()
  end
end
function Movement.teleport(snap, destination)
  Movement.cancel()
  snap.character:PivotTo(typeof(destination) == "CFrame" and destination or CFrame.new(destination))
  snap.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity, snap.root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
  return true
end
Movement.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "teardown", "bind", "cancel", "busy", "owner", "walk", "step", "teleport" }, requires = {} }
return Movement

-- [[ mm2 native ]]
--!optimize 2

local Native = {}
local Utils
local service, source, pending
local Input = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local function clientOf(tool, script) return typeof(script) == "Instance" and script:IsA("LocalScript") and script:IsDescendantOf(tool) end
local function valid(job)
  return Utils.isActive()
    and Utils.getLocalPlayer().Character == job.character
    and job.tool.Parent == job.character
    and job.tool.Enabled
    and job.tool:GetAttribute("Disabled") ~= true
    and job.humanoid.Parent
    and job.humanoid.Health > 0
    and (not job.allowed or job.allowed())
end
function Native.setup(deps)
  Native.teardown()
  Utils = deps.Utils
  return true
end
function Native.reset()
  local job = pending
  pending = nil
  if not job then
    return
  end
  for name, patch in pairs(job.patches) do
    if job.service[name] == patch.wrapper then
      job.service[name] = patch.original
    end
  end
  if job.action then
    pcall(function() job.action:Fire(false) end)
  end
  if job.kind == "throw" and not job.aimed and job.tool.Parent == job.character and job.humanoid.Parent then
    job.humanoid:UnequipTools()
  end
end
function Native.teardown()
  Native.reset()
  service, source = nil, nil
end
function Native.busy() return pending ~= nil end
local function weaponService()
  local folder = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("ClientServices")
  local current = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("WeaponService")
  if current ~= source then
    service, source = nil, current
  end
  if not current or not current:IsA("ModuleScript") then
    return
  end
  if not service then
    local ok, value = pcall(require, current)
    if ok and type(value) == "table" then
      service = value
    end
  end
  return service
end
local function touchCallbacks(tool)
  local env = type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv() or _G
  if type(env.getconnections) ~= "function" then
    return
  end
  local ok, connections = pcall(env.getconnections, Input.TouchTapInWorld)
  if not ok or type(connections) ~= "table" then
    return
  end
  local result = {}
  for _, connection in pairs(connections) do
    local readable, callback, enabled = pcall(function() return connection.Function, connection.Enabled end)
    if not readable or type(callback) ~= "function" or enabled == false then
      continue
    end
    local scoped, environment = pcall(getfenv, callback)
    if scoped and environment and clientOf(tool, environment.script) then
      result[#result + 1] = callback
    end
  end
  return #result > 0 and result or nil
end
local function throwAction()
  local gui = Utils.getLocalPlayer():FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
  local context = gui and gui:FindFirstChild("InputContext")
  local gameplay = context and context:FindFirstChild("GameplayContext")
  local action = gameplay and gameplay:FindFirstChild("Throw")
  return action and action:IsA("InputAction") and action
end
local function mount(job)
  for _, name in ipairs({ "GetMouseTargetCFrame", "GetTargetPosition" }) do
    local original = job.service[name]
    if type(original) ~= "function" then
      return false
    end
    local function wrapper(self, ...)
      local caller = getfenv(2).script
      if pending == job and valid(job) and clientOf(job.tool, caller) then
        job.aimed = true
        return job.target
      end
      return original(self, ...)
    end
    job.patches[name] = { original = original, wrapper = wrapper }
    local ok = pcall(function() job.service[name] = wrapper end)
    if not ok or job.service[name] ~= wrapper then
      return false
    end
  end
  return true
end
function Native.stab(snap, tool, allowed)
  if pending or not tool or not tool:IsA("Tool") then
    return false
  end
  local job = { tool = tool, character = snap.character, humanoid = snap.humanoid, allowed = allowed }
  if not valid(job) then
    return false
  end
  local ok, reason = pcall(function() tool:Activate() end)
  return ok, not ok and tostring(reason) or nil
end
function Native.throw(snap, tool, target, allowed)
  if pending then
    return false, "Aguarde a ação nativa terminar."
  end
  if typeof(target) ~= "CFrame" or not tool or not tool:IsA("Tool") then
    return false, "Arma ou alvo indisponível."
  end
  local api = weaponService()
  if not api then
    return false, "WeaponService nativo indisponível."
  end
  local action, callbacks = throwAction(), touchCallbacks(tool)
  if not action or not callbacks then
    return false, "O controle nativo de lançamento não está acessível neste executor."
  end
  local charge = tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("ThrowSpeed"))
  if not charge or charge ~= charge or charge < 0 or charge > 10 then
    return false, "Tempo nativo de lançamento indisponível."
  end
  local now = os.clock()
  local job = {
    kind = "throw",
    tool = tool,
    character = snap.character,
    humanoid = snap.humanoid,
    service = api,
    patches = {},
    target = target,
    allowed = allowed,
    action = action,
    callbacks = callbacks,
    confirmAt = now + charge,
    expires = now + charge + 1,
  }
  if not valid(job) then
    return false, "A arma nativa não está pronta."
  end
  pending = job
  if not mount(job) then
    Native.reset()
    return false, "A mira nativa do MM2 não pôde ser conectada."
  end
  local ok, reason = pcall(function()
    action:Fire(true)
    action:Fire(false)
  end)
  if not ok then
    Native.reset()
    return false, tostring(reason)
  end
  return true
end
function Native.step()
  local job = pending
  if not job then
    return
  end
  if not valid(job) or os.clock() >= job.expires then
    Native.reset()
    return
  end
  for name, patch in pairs(job.patches) do
    if job.service[name] ~= patch.wrapper then
      Native.reset()
      return
    end
  end
  if job.aimed then
    Native.reset()
    return
  end
  if job.kind ~= "throw" or os.clock() < job.confirmAt then
    return
  end
  local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
  if not camera then
    Native.reset()
    return
  end
  local point = camera.ViewportSize / 2
  for _, callback in ipairs(job.callbacks) do
    if pending ~= job or job.aimed then
      break
    end
    local ok, reason = pcall(callback, point, false)
    if not ok then
      Native.reset()
      Utils.recordError("mm2.native.throw", tostring(reason))
      return
    end
  end
end
Native.__contract = {
  provides = { "setup", "reset", "teardown", "busy", "stab", "throw", "step" },
  requires = { Utils = "utils" },
  requiresMethods = { Utils = { "isActive", "getLocalPlayer", "recordError" } },
}
return Native

-- [[ mm2 state ]]
--!optimize 2

local State = {}
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Storage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local scope, data, bags, revision, epoch = nil, {}, {}, 0, 0
local cachedMap, mapScanAt = nil, 0
local function remote(name)
  local remotes = Storage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
  local gameplay = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Gameplay")
  return gameplay and gameplay:FindFirstChild(name)
end
local function accept(value)
  if type(value) ~= "table" then
    return
  end
  local clean = {}
  for name, profile in pairs(value) do
    if type(name) == "string" and type(profile) == "table" then
      clean[name] = { Role = profile.Role, Dead = profile.Dead == true, Killed = profile.Killed == true }
    end
  end
  data, revision = clean, revision + 1
end
function State.setup() return true end
function State.teardown()
  epoch += 1
  if scope then
    scope.destroy()
    scope = nil
  end
  data, bags, revision = {}, {}, 0
  cachedMap, mapScanAt = nil, 0
end
function State.bind(lifetime)
  State.teardown()
  scope = lifetime.child()
  local owner, generation = scope, epoch
  local bound = {}
  local fetched = false
  local function attach(name, callback)
    local source = remote(name)
    if source == bound[name] then
      return
    end
    if bound[name .. "Connection"] then
      owner.remove(bound[name .. "Connection"])
    end
    bound[name] = source
    if source and source:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
      bound[name .. "Connection"] = owner.connect(source.OnClientEvent, callback)
    end
  end
  local function discover()
    attach("PlayerDataChanged", accept)
    attach("RoundEndFade", function()
      data, bags = {}, {}
      revision += 1
    end)
    attach("CoinsStarted", function(currencies)
      bags = {}
      if type(currencies) == "table" then
        for name in pairs(currencies) do
          bags[name] = false
        end
      end
    end)
    attach("CoinCollected", function(currency, count, limit)
      if type(currency) == "string" and type(count) == "number" and type(limit) == "number" then
        bags[currency] = limit > 0 and count >= limit
      end
    end)
    local source = remote("GetCurrentPlayerData")
    if not fetched and source and source:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
      fetched = true
      local version = revision
      local thread = task.defer(function()
        local ok, result = pcall(function() return source:InvokeServer() end)
        if owner.alive and epoch == generation and revision == version and ok then
          accept(result)
        end
      end)
      owner.add(thread, function() pcall(task.cancel, thread) end)
    end
  end
  owner.connect(Storage.DescendantAdded, function(object)
    if
      object.Name == "Gameplay"
      or object.Name == "GetCurrentPlayerData"
      or object:IsA("RemoteEvent") and object.Parent and object.Parent.Name == "Gameplay"
    then
      discover()
    end
  end)
  owner.connect(workspace.ChildAdded, function()
    cachedMap, mapScanAt = nil, 0
  end)
  owner.connect(workspace.ChildRemoved, function(object)
    if object == cachedMap then
      cachedMap, mapScanAt = nil, 0
    end
  end)
  discover()
end
function State.map()
  if cachedMap and cachedMap.Parent == workspace and cachedMap:GetAttribute("MapID") ~= nil then
    return cachedMap
  end
  if os.clock() < mapScanAt then
    return
  end
  cachedMap, mapScanAt = nil, os.clock() + 0.25
  for _, object in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
    if object:IsA("Model") and object:GetAttribute("MapID") ~= nil then
      cachedMap = object
      return object
    end
  end
end
function State.profile(player) return player and data[player.Name] end
function State.role(player)
  local profile = State.profile(player)
  return profile and profile.Role
end
function State.live(player, round)
  if not player then
    return
  end
  local character = player.Character
  local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") or not character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
    return
  end
  if round then
    local profile = State.profile(player)
    if not State.map() or player:GetAttribute("Alive") ~= true or not profile or profile.Dead or profile.Killed then
      return
    end
  end
  return { player = player, character = character, humanoid = humanoid, root = root, role = State.role(player) }
end
function State.findRole(role)
  for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    if State.role(player) == role then
      local target = State.live(player, true)
      if target then
        return target
      end
    end
  end
end
function State.full()
  local any = false
  for _, full in pairs(bags) do
    any = true
    if not full then
      return false
    end
  end
  return any
end
function State.tool(snap, name, equip)
  local tool = snap.character:FindFirstChild(name)
  local backpack = snap.player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
  tool = tool or backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild(name)
  if not tool or not tool:IsA("Tool") then
    return
  end
  if equip and tool.Parent ~= snap.character then
    snap.humanoid:EquipTool(tool)
  end
  return tool
end
State.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "teardown", "bind", "map", "profile", "role", "live", "findRole", "full", "tool" }, requires = {} }
return State

-- [[ mm2 world ]]
--!optimize 2

local World = {}
local Collection = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local coinScope
local state, scope, map, coins, guns = nil, nil, nil, {}, {}
function World.setup(deps)
  state = deps.State
  return true
end
function World.teardown()
  if scope then
    scope.destroy()
    scope = nil
  end
  map, coins, guns, coinScope = nil, {}, {}, nil
end
function World.bind(lifetime)
  World.teardown()
  scope = lifetime.child()
  local function tagged(object) guns[object] = true end
  for _, object in ipairs(Collection:GetTagged("GunDrop")) do
    tagged(object)
  end
  scope.connect(Collection:GetInstanceAddedSignal("GunDrop"), tagged)
  scope.connect(Collection:GetInstanceRemovedSignal("GunDrop"), function(object) guns[object] = nil end)
end
function World.refresh()
  local current = state.map()
  local container = current and current:FindFirstChild("CoinContainer")
  if container == map then
    return
  end
  if scope and coinScope then
    scope.remove(coinScope)
    coinScope = nil
  end
  map, coins = container, {}
  if not container or not scope then
    return
  end
  local owner = scope.child()
  coinScope = owner
  local function add(object)
    if object:IsA("BasePart") then
      coins[object] = true
    end
  end
  owner.connect(container.ChildAdded, add)
  owner.connect(container.ChildRemoved, function(object) coins[object] = nil end)
  for _, object in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
    add(object)
  end
end
function World.collectable(part)
  if not part.Parent or not map or not part:IsDescendantOf(map) or part:GetAttribute("Collected") or not part:FindFirstChild("TouchInterest") then
    return false
  end
  local kind = string.lower(tostring(part:GetAttribute("CoinID") or ""))
  local visual = part:FindFirstChild("CoinVisual")
  if visual and (visual:GetAttribute("Delete") or visual:GetAttribute("Collected")) then
    return false
  end
  if kind == "candy" then
    return true
  end
  local main = visual and visual:FindFirstChild("MainCoin")
  return main ~= nil and main:IsA("BasePart") and main.Transparency < 0.95
end
function World.position(object)
  if object:IsA("BasePart") then
    return object.Position
  end
  if object:IsA("Model") then
    return object:GetPivot().Position
  end
end
function World.coins() return coins end
function World.guns() return guns end
function World.nearest(origin, objects, filter)
  local best, point, distance = nil, nil, math.huge
  for object in pairs(objects) do
    if object.Parent and object:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and (not filter or filter(object)) then
      local position = World.position(object)
      local delta = position and (origin - position).Magnitude
      if delta and delta < distance then
        best, point, distance = object, position, delta
      end
    end
  end
  return best, point, distance
end
World.__contract = {
  provides = { "setup", "teardown", "bind", "refresh", "collectable", "position", "coins", "guns", "nearest" },
  requires = { State = "mm2state" },
  requiresMethods = { State = { "map" } },
}
return World
